title: Tokyo Imperial Palace Guide
description: Just ten minutes from Tokyo Station lies Tokyo Imperial Palace: a wealth of gardens and galleries, with guided tours and castle ruins. If you’re planning to visit, there are organized tours of inner areas available for free, as well as special days when you can see the Emperor himself—so read on and learn all you need to know about Tokyo Imperial Palace and the treasures it holds!

title: 東京皇居ガイド
description: 東京駅からわずか10分の場所にある東京皇居：庭園やギャラリーが豊富で、ガイド付きツアーや城の遺跡があります。訪問を計画している場合は、無料で内側のエリアの組織されたツアーがあり、天皇自身を見ることができる特別な日もあるので、東京皇居とその宝物について知っておくべきことを読み進めてください！

title: Shinkansen Guide: Everything You Need to Know About Japan's Superfast Bullet Trains
description: Wondering whether the Shinkansen (that’s the bullet train) might be the best way to get from one part of Japan to another? This is a comprehensive guide to taking some of the fastest trains in the world, from speeds to seat reservations, luggage and the Japan rail passes.

title: 新幹線ガイド：日本の超高速列車について知っておくべきことすべて
description: 新幹線（つまり、バレットトレイン）が日本の一部から別の部分へ移動する最良の方法かどうか疑問に思っていますか？これは、世界で最も速い列車のいくつかを利用するための包括的なガイドで、速度、座席予約、荷物、そして日本の鉄道パスについて説明しています。

title: Bike Tours in Japan with Robert Mcmanmon
description: What's it like cycling across Japan? Where are the best places to go on a bike tour? and with all the steep mountains, is this an activity only for pros?

title: 日本のバイクツアー - ロバート・マクマモンと共に
description: 日本を自転車で横断するのはどんな感じですか？バイクツアーに最適な場所はどこですか？そして、急な山が多い中で、これはプロだけの活動なのでしょうか？

description: Snoopy is loved the world over—and Japan is no exception! We take you inside the new Snoopy Museum and Cafe, which has moved from its original location in Roppongi to a bigger and better venue about 34min from Shibuya Station on the Tokyu Den-En-Toshi Line.

description: スヌーピーは世界中で愛されていますが、日本も例外ではありません！私たちは、六本木から移転した新しいスヌーピー美術館とカフェの内部を紹介します。渋谷駅から東急田園都市線で約34分の場所にある、より大きくて良い会場です。

description: We went down to the new Tokyo Night Market — created by the team behind the long-standing Farmer’s Market in Aoyama — to see what all the fuss is about, and it didn't disappoint. Filling a gap in Tokyo's evening scene, the Night Market houses a range of stalls selling homewares, clothing, art, crafts and more, plus international food trucks. Don't forget about the live art, friendly atmosphere and a rotating schedule of culinary events.

description: 新しい東京ナイトマーケットに行ってきました。青山の長年続くファーマーズマーケットのチームが作ったもので、期待を裏切りませんでした。東京の夜のシーンの隙間を埋めるナイトマーケットでは、家庭用品、衣類、アート、クラフトなどのさまざまな屋台や国際的なフードトラックが揃っています。ライブアート、フレンドリーな雰囲気、そして料理イベントのローテーションスケジュールもお見逃しなく。

title: Hiroshima Day Trip Guide
description: We explore Hiroshima — a place known for its haunting history, but its resilience even more so. Follow our day trip guide to take in all it has to offer.

description: We visit our favorite (read: cheapest) maid cafes in Akihabara. These types of cafes are one of Japan’s pop culture icons.

description: The Boroichi Market comes around twice a year (Jan 15-16 and Dec 15-16) and it's not to be missed. Peruse the stalls selling housewares, plants, antiques and more. Plus there are plenty of food and drink stalls. Don't forget to get a cup of amazake—a traditional Japanese hot drink made from fermented rice.

title: 東京の400年の歴史を持つぼろいち市場
description: ぼろいち市場は年に2回（1月15-16日と12月15-16日）開催され、見逃せません。家庭用品、植物、骨董品などを販売する屋台を見て回りましょう。さらに、食べ物や飲み物の屋台もたくさんあります。発酵米から作られた伝統的な日本のホットドリンク、甘酒を忘れずに飲んでください。

description: これらのショップに行けないですか？オンラインでもレトロゲームを探すことができます: https://shop.buyee.jp/takaramo/shopping/search/category/c20930?rc=af_japancheapo21&mrc1=buyee&mrc2=media&mrc3=af_japancheapo21

title: A Beginner's Guide to Jiyugaoka: Tokyo's Little Europe
description: Thanks to its cobblestone roads, stylish boutiques and many bakeries, #Jiyugaoka is the 'Little Europe' of #Tokyo.

title: 自由が丘入門ガイド：東京の小さなヨーロッパ
description: 石畳の道、スタイリッシュなブティック、そして多くのベーカリーのおかげで、#自由が丘は#東京の「小さなヨーロッパ」です。

title: Import Shops in Tokyo
description: Get your back-home favorites at these Tokyo import stores selling international brands of classic pantry items, cheeses, meats, plus beer, wine and liquors!

title: 東京の輸入ショップ
description: 国際的なブランドのクラシックなパントリーアイテム、チーズ、肉、ビール、ワイン、リキュールを販売するこれらの東京の輸入店で、故郷のお気に入りを手に入れましょう！

title: Free and Cheap Things to Do in Shinjuku
description: Explore the best of Shinjuku (one of Tokyo's most popular neighborhoods) without having to spend a fortune—lush parks, city views and local charm!

title: 新宿での無料および安価なアクティビティ
description: 東京の最も人気のある地域の一つである新宿を、手頃な価格で楽しむ方法を探求しましょう。緑豊かな公園、都市の景色、地元の魅力！

title: A Beginner's Guide to Kawagoe (Little Edo)
description: Kawagoe is an easy day trip from Tokyo where you can travel back to traditional Japan. In this former castle town, there's plenty of Edo-era architecture, temples, shrines and Buddha statues.

title: 川越への初心者ガイド (小江戸)
description: 川越は東京から簡単に日帰り旅行ができる場所で、伝統的な日本に戻ることができます。この元城下町には、江戸時代の建築、寺院、神社、仏像がたくさんあります。

title: A Beginner's Guide to Azabu-Juban
description: Azabu-Juban is a low-key neighbourhood in Tokyo, but with lots to offer. It's got trendy shops and cafes, and a bit of European flair with its cobbled roads and Western-style architecture. It's also home to import shops and international business (and many foreigners as well).

title: アザブ十番の初心者ガイド
description: アザブ十番は東京の落ち着いた地域ですが、多くの魅力があります。トレンディなショップやカフェがあり、石畳の道や西洋風の建築で少しヨーロッパの雰囲気を感じられます。また、輸入ショップや国際ビジネスの拠点でもあり、多くの外国人も住んでいます。

title: A Beginner's Guide to Daikanyama
description: #Daikanyama, aka "Little Brooklyn", is one of #Tokyo's trendiest neighborhoods. Filled with cool shops, cafes, restaurants and architecture, you'll want to stroll around all day long.

title: ダイカンヤマ初心者ガイド
description: #ダイカンヤマ、別名「リトルブルックリン」は、#東京で最もトレンディな地区の一つです。クールなショップ、カフェ、レストラン、建築が満載で、一日中散策したくなるでしょう。

title: Asakusa in 2018
description: #Asakusa is one of the top tourist destinations in #Tokyo thanks to famous sights such as #Sensoji Temple, Nakamise Dori, the nearby #Skytree and more! Plus it's a great area for traditional eats and souvenirs.

title: 2018年の浅草
description: #浅草は、#東京の主要な観光地の一つで、#浅草寺、仲見世通り、近くの#スカイツリーなどの有名な観光名所があります！さらに、伝統的な食事やお土産を楽しむのにも最適なエリアです。

title: Top Shops for Cheap Souvenirs in Tokyo
description: You've got a long list of people to buy for, but not the wallet to back it up? Try 3 of our favorite shops for buying budget-friendly souvenirs in Tokyo!

title: 東京で安いお土産を買えるお店トップ
description: 買うべき人がたくさんいるけれど、財布がそれに見合わない？東京で予算に優しいお土産を買うための私たちのお気に入りの3つのお店を試してみてください！

title: Tokyo Cheapo's Guide to Love Hotels
description: Love hotels can be found all over Tokyo — and they can come in handy in terms of convenience, price and privacy for you and your bae. Watch on for an inside look at what to expect.

title: 東京のラブホテルガイド
description: ラブホテルは東京中にあり、あなたとあなたの恋人にとって便利さ、価格、プライバシーの面で役立ちます。何を期待するかの内部の様子を見てみましょう。

title: Tokyo to Osaka: Cheapest and Fastest Transport Options
description: You don't want to blow your budget on transportation. See our tips on keeping travel costs and times down between Tokyo and Osaka (aka 'Japan's Kitchen').

title: 東京から大阪：最も安くて速い交通手段
description: 予算を交通費に使いたくないですか？東京と大阪（「日本の台所」とも呼ばれる）間の旅行コストと時間を抑えるためのヒントをご覧ください。

title: A Beginner's Guide to Ramen
description: #Ramen, Japan's most beloved dish, can come in many tastes and toppings. Here's our guide on what it is and where to grab a bowl in #Tokyo!

title: 初心者のためのラーメンガイド
description: #ラーメン、日本で最も愛されている料理は、さまざまな味やトッピングがあります。ここでは、ラーメンとは何か、そして#東京でどこで一杯を楽しむことができるかについてのガイドを紹介します！

title: Tokyo to Kyoto: Cheapest and Fastest Transport Options
description: You don't want to blow your budget on transportation. See our tips on keeping travel costs and times down between #Tokyo and #Kyoto—Japan's two most famous cities.

title: 東京から京都：最も安くて速い交通手段
description: 編集：おっと！京都と東京の距離は364 km（226マイル）です！

title: A Beginner's Guide to Ameya-Yokocho
description: #AmeyaYokocho is one of Tokyo's busiest #market streets where you can find great bargain buys—from clothing, accessories, cosmetics, fresh fish and more! Plus there plenty of traditional eateries to choose from.

title: アメヤ横丁の初心者ガイド
description: #アメヤ横丁は東京で最も賑やかな#市場通りの一つで、衣類、アクセサリー、化粧品、新鮮な魚などの素晴らしいバargainを見つけることができます！さらに、選べる伝統的な飲食店もたくさんあります。

title: A Beginner's Guide to Yanaka
description: #Yanaka is a quiet #Tokyo neighborhood with a popular #market street, a beautiful sakura-lined cemetery and plenty of temples.

title: ヤナカ初心者ガイド
description: #ヤナカは静かな#東京の近隣で、人気の#マーケットストリート、美しい桜並木の墓地、そしてたくさんの寺院があります。

title: A Beginner's Guide to Ikebukuro
description: #Ikebukuro is a commercial and #entertainment district in Tokyo and is home to the world's 2nd busiest train station. It is often described as a mix between #Akihabara and #Shibuya—there is a little something for everyone.

title: 池袋初心者ガイド
description: #池袋は東京の商業および#エンターテイメント地区であり、世界で2番目に忙しい鉄道駅があります。#秋葉原と#渋谷の間のミックスとしてしばしば説明され、誰にでも少しずつ何かがあります。

title: Shopping for Cheapos: Tokyo City Flea Market
description: Tokyo flea markets are a great for bargain-hunting. You can outfit your apartment, pick up a new kimono or snag a new book on a shoestring. And don't forget to haggle for a discount!

title: 安いものを探す: 東京のフリーマーケット
description: 東京のフリーマーケットは、掘り出し物を探すのに最適です。アパートを整えたり、新しい着物を手に入れたり、安く新しい本を手に入れたりできます。そして、割引の交渉を忘れないでください！

title: 2017 Sakura Season in Tokyo
description: Springtime in Japan is as beautiful as advertised - especially because of the iconic cherry blossoms. Here are some of the most popular spots in Tokyo to see them for yourself.

title: 2017年の東京の桜シーズン
description: 日本の春は宣伝通り美しい - 特に象徴的な桜のために。ここでは、東京で桜を見るための最も人気のあるスポットをいくつか紹介します。

title: A Cheapo's Day Trip Guide to Yokohama
description: #Yokohama is just south of Tokyo and the 2nd largest city in Japan. There are lots to do, from enjoying beautiful views, shopping and eating at Asia's biggest #Chinatown.

title: 安い人の横浜日帰り旅行ガイド
description: #横浜は東京の南にあり、日本で2番目に大きな都市です。美しい景色を楽しんだり、アジア最大の#中華街で買い物や食事をしたりすることがたくさんあります。

title: Shibuya in 2017
description: #Shibuya, one of the most popular areas of Tokyo, is the go-to neighborhood for entertainment, shopping, #fashion, and cuisine (both local and international). It’s also home to the iconic scramble crossing.

title: 2017年の渋谷
description: #渋谷は、東京で最も人気のあるエリアの一つで、エンターテイメント、ショッピング、#ファッション、そして地元および国際的な料理のための行きつけの場所です。また、象徴的なスクランブル交差点もあります。

title: The Japan Rail Pass - Should You Buy One?
description: Cheapos Aaron and Chris help answer the infamous 'Should I buy a Japan Rail Pass?' question, as well as run you through some other transportation options for getting around Japan.

title: 日本鉄道パス - 購入すべきか？
description: チープなアーロンとクリスが「日本鉄道パスを購入すべきか？」という有名な質問に答え、また日本を移動するための他の交通手段についても説明します。

title: Odaiba in 2017
description: #Odaiba is a man-made island in Tokyo Bay offering picturesque views of the city's waterfront. There are tons of attractions in the area including views of Rainbow #Bridge, shopping, museums, entertainment centers—and (well until recently, as it's now gone!) the famous #Gundam statue.

title: お台場 2017
description: #お台場は東京湾にある人工島で、街のウォーターフロントの美しい景色を提供しています。レインボーブリッジの景色、ショッピング、博物館、エンターテイメントセンターなど、たくさんのアトラクションがあります—そして（最近まで、今はなくなってしまいましたが！）有名な#ガンダム像もありました。

title: A Beginner's Guide to Harajuku
description: For a look into the unique world of Japanese youth culture and fashion, make Harajuku no. 1 on your list of places to visit in Tokyo. The (ever-crowded) Takeshita Street is where you want to start for fashion boutiques, themed cafes, iconic crepes, and full immersion into Japanese pop culture.

title: 原宿初心者ガイド
description: 日本の若者文化とファッションのユニークな世界を覗くために、東京で訪れるべき場所の1位に原宿をリストアップしてください。常に混雑している竹下通りは、ファッションブティック、テーマカフェ、アイコニックなクレープ、そして日本のポップカルチャーに完全に浸るためのスタート地点です。

title: Akihabara in 2017
description: #Akihabara is the geek capital of the world — but whether or not you identify as one, it’s still worth a visit to experience Japan’s unique #otaku culture. Our beginner’s guide runs you through the highlights: electronic and gamer shops, #anime goods, famous sex shops, cheap eats and more!

title: 秋葉原 2017
description: #秋葉原は世界のオタクの首都ですが、オタク文化に興味がない方でも、日本のユニークな文化を体験するために訪れる価値があります。初心者向けガイドでは、電子機器やゲームショップ、#アニメ商品、有名な性風俗店、安い食事などのハイライトを紹介します！

title: Shimokitazawa Nightlife: Cool Japanese Bars and Hangouts
description: Shimokitazawa – a vintage, bohemian neighborhood only a few stops from central Tokyo – has plenty of cool bars, hangouts and nightlife options. Have a look inside one of our favorites: Mother's Ruin.

title: 下北沢のナイトライフ：クールな日本のバーとハングアウト
description: 下北沢 - 中央東京から数駅のところにあるビンテージでボヘミアンな街並み - には、クールなバーやハングアウト、ナイトライフの選択肢がたくさんあります。私たちのお気に入りの一つ、マザーズ・ルーインの内部を覗いてみましょう。

title: A Beginner's Guide to Nakano Broadway
description: #Nakano Broadway is a large shopping center in Nakano, Tokyo geared towards #otaku (or "geek") culture. It provides a good alternative to the popular #Akihabara district since you can avoid the duty-free shops, avoid tourist traps and find old-school anime merch.

title: ナカノブロードウェイ入門ガイド
description: #ナカノブロードウェイは、東京の中野にある大規模なショッピングセンターで、#オタク（または「ギーク」）文化に特化しています。人気の#秋葉原地区の代替として良い選択肢を提供し、免税店や観光客向けの罠を避け、古いアニメ商品を見つけることができます。

title: Shinjuku in 2016
description: A mini Shinjuku travel guide for beginners — one of Tokyo's most popular wards, famous for its skyscrapers, shopping, the Shinjuku Gyoen national park, and home to the world's busiest station (an adventure on its own!).

title: 新宿 2016
description: 初心者のためのミニ新宿旅行ガイド - 東京で最も人気のある区の一つで、高層ビル、ショッピング、新宿御苑国立公園で有名で、世界で最も混雑する駅の本拠地（それ自体が冒険です！）。

title: Tokyo Kimono Rental Experience
description: Add a touch of tradition to your time in Tokyo! This week, we visit rental shop Nadeshiko and walk you through the basic kimono experience.

title: 東京の着物レンタル体験
description: 東京での時間に伝統を加えましょう！今週はレンタルショップ「なでしこ」を訪れ、基本的な着物体験を紹介します。

title: Tokyo Mountain Hikes: Alternatives To Mount Fuji
description: Want to take in the iconic beauty that is Mount Fuji? Then hit the trails of two nearby Tokyo mountains: Mount Akadake and Mount Mitake. From their summits, you’ll get a spectacular view of #Fuji and the surrounding Tokyo area.

title: 東京の山のハイキング: 富士山の代替案
description: 富士山の象徴的な美しさを楽しみたいですか？それなら、東京の近くにある2つの山、赤岳と御岳のトレイルを歩いてみてください。山頂からは、富士山と東京周辺の素晴らしい景色を楽しむことができます。

title: Getting WiFi In Japan
description: It's getting easier to find WiFi in Japan. There's a lot more free wifi available, plus you can now buy data SIM cards and rent WiFi routers.

title: 日本でのWiFiの取得
description: 日本でWiFiを見つけるのが簡単になっています。無料WiFiが増えているほか、データSIMカードを購入したり、WiFiルーターをレンタルしたりすることもできます。

title: Shimokitazawa in 2016
description: Shimokitazwa - a veritable cheapo's paradise. Thrifting, vintage and secondhand shopping, hipster hangouts, live music, cheap restaurants - a calm bohemian neighbourhood in the heart of Tokyo.

title: 2016年の下北沢
description: 下北沢 - 実に安価なパラダイス。リサイクル、ヴィンテージや中古品のショッピング、ヒップスターの集まる場所、ライブ音楽、安いレストラン - 東京の中心にある穏やかなボヘミアンな地域。

title: Design Festa - Japan's Largest Art and Design Event
description: Design Festa, Asia's largest art festival and a veritable treasure trove of the arty, quirky and bizarre - we went down to investigate. It's a great place to get a taste of young contemporary creativity and subculture in Japan, definitely worth checking out.

title: デザインフェスタ - 日本最大のアートとデザインイベント
description: デザインフェスタは、アジア最大のアートフェスティバルであり、アート、奇妙なもの、そして奇抜なものの宝庫です。私たちは調査に行きました。若い現代の創造性とサブカルチャーを味わうのに最適な場所で、ぜひ訪れてみてください。

title: What is a Yokocho? Tokyo’s Culinary and Boozey Back Streets
description: Yokochos are one of Tokyo's best kept secrets, back alleys crammed with little bars and eateries serving traditional Japanese fare.

title: 横丁とは？東京の料理と酒の裏通り
description: 横丁は東京の隠れた宝物で、伝統的な日本料理を提供する小さなバーや食堂が詰まった裏路地です。

title: Best Free Tokyo Views
description: Where to get the best view of Tokyo? Here's our favourite 5 free view spots in Tokyo.

title: 東京の無料の絶景スポット
description: 東京の絶景を楽しむにはどこがいい？ここでは、東京の無料の絶景スポット5選を紹介します。

description: 1995年に発生した阪神・淡路大震災の記憶を後世に語り継ぐとともに、神戸の希望を象徴する行事として開催してきた「神戸ルミナリエ」。2025年1月に節目となる第30回開催を迎えます。

title: 30th Kobe Luminarie | Held for 10 days from January 24, 2025
description: The 'Kobe Luminarie' has been held as an event to pass on the memory of the Great Hanshin-Awaji Earthquake that occurred in 1995 and to symbolize hope for Kobe. The 30th event will take place in January 2025.

description: 関西国際大学の学生が「神戸の食」について、撮影を実施しました！撮影から動画の編集に至るまで、学生自身で制作。神戸は食の魅力があふれる街。神戸といったら欠かせない神戸牛や、今流行りのレトロ喫茶、定番のお土産として定着しているチーズケーキのお店まで、内容盛りだくさん！要チェックです✨

title: KUISs×神戸観光局
description: Students from Kansai University of International Studies conducted a shoot about 'Kobe's food'! From shooting to video editing, the students created it themselves. Kobe is a city full of culinary charm. You can't talk about Kobe without mentioning Kobe beef, the trendy retro cafes, and the cheesecake shops that have become a staple souvenir. It's packed with content! Be sure to check it out✨

title: KUISs×KOBE TOURISM BUREAU
description: 関西国際大学の学生が神戸のホットスポットとして「神戸ポートミュージアム(KPM)」の撮影を実施しました！撮影から動画の編集に至るまで、学生自身で制作。見たいもの・食べたいもの魅力が詰まった動画です。是非神戸観光のご参考に、ご覧ください☺✨

title: KUISs×KOBE TOURISM BUREAU

From shooting to video editing, the students created it themselves. It's a video filled with things you want to see and eat. Please take a look as a reference for your Kobe sightseeing ☺✨

title: Kansai Japan ~ Osaka, Sakai, Kobe, Himeji, Koyasan ~
関西日本 ~ 大阪、堺、神戸、姫路、高野山 ~

title: Kansai Japan ~Osaka, Sakai, Kobe, Himeji, Koyasan~［30 seconds ver.］
description: There are many places to worth a visit in Japan. This video introduces some of the most attractive spots in the Kansai region of Japan. There are historic places, World Heritage sites and cultural traditions, food and more.. In this video, we picked up five places: Kobe, Osaka, Sakai, Himeji and Koyasan. When you visit Japan, touring these areas is a must. We hope that this video will inspire you for your next trip to Japan!

title: 「神戸は、地球だ。」～ヨーロッパ編～ 【神戸で海外旅行 キャンペーン動画】
description: In a café like Milan, savoring espresso, enjoying authentic cuisine reminiscent of Paris in a retro Western-style mansion. Indulging in sweets at a café with an atmosphere like a German church, checking into a hotel that seems to be in the resort of southern France. Looking down at the city from a tower resembling an English castle, I suddenly wonder. Wait, is this Europe? This is a tourism PR video for Kobe, a city where you can experience European travel while in Japan.

title: 「神戸は、地球だ。」～アメリカ編～ 【神戸で海外旅行 キャンペーン動画】
description: Check out a cute hotel that seems to be on the West Coast, stroll along a waterfront reminiscent of Seattle, take commemorative photos on a street that looks like a corner in New York, and enjoy seafood at a restaurant that could be in San Francisco. After watching the sunset on a beautiful beach like in Los Angeles, you might wonder, 'Wait, is this America?' This is a tourism PR video for Kobe, a city where you can enjoy an American trip while being in Japan.

title: 「神戸は、地球だ。」～ダイジェスト編～ 【神戸で海外旅行 キャンペーン動画】
description: アメリカの懐の深さに甘えたり、ヨーロッパの歴史から学んだり、アジアのごはんで元気になったり、地球は私にとっての、充電器見たいなものかも。でも、海外旅行はなかなか....って、あれ？それ全部、神戸でできちゃう？日本にいながら海外旅行ができる街・神戸の観光PR動画です⚓

title: Kobe is the Earth.
description: I might be relying on the depth of America, learning from European history, and getting energized by Asian food. The Earth might be like a charger for me. But overseas travel is quite difficult... Wait, can I do all of that in Kobe? This is a tourism PR video for Kobe, a city where you can enjoy overseas travel while in Japan ⚓

title: 「神戸は、地球だ。」～アジア編～【神戸で海外旅行 キャンペーン動画】
description: After visiting a temple that seems to be in Shanghai, I stroll through a street that smells of spices, reminiscent of the Middle East. After a satisfying lunch that feels like royal cuisine from Beijing, I take a moment to relax at an authentic tea house that seems to be in Taiwan. As I gaze at the neon lights and lanterns reminiscent of a night market in Hong Kong, I suddenly wonder, 'Wait, is this really Asia?' This is a promotional video for tourism in Kobe, a city where you can experience an Asian trip while being in Japan.

title: NIGHT EXPLORING IN KOBE -  DAY2
description: Take a cable car, find a nostalgic souvenir and rest at a café along with the view. Why don’t you grab some Sake on your way back at Mikage?

description: 1868年5月16日に、国宝・十一面観音立像が大御輪寺から聖林寺に移されたというエピソードを踏まえ、奈良県桜井市の古刹・聖林寺より、住職・倉本　明佳　師をお招きし、「国宝・十一面観音立像」の魅力など、お子様にもわかりやすく心が安らぐお話をしていただきます。ご法話の後、不安や閉塞感を感じることが多い今、疫病退散や健康、安寧を願い写経体験をして頂きます。

title: Seirinji Special Dharma Talk and Sutra Copying Experience Course: "The Prayer of the Eleven-Headed Kannon of Seirinji"
description: Based on the episode that the National Treasure, the Eleven-Headed Kannon statue, was moved from Omihonji Temple to Seirinji on May 16, 1868, we invite the chief priest, Akira Kuramoto, from the ancient temple Seirinji in Sakurai City, Nara Prefecture, to give a calming talk about the charm of the National Treasure, the Eleven-Headed Kannon statue, in a way that is easy for children to understand. After the Dharma talk, participants will have the opportunity to experience sutra copying, wishing for the dispelling of epidemics, health, and peace in these times of anxiety and stagnation.

title: 奈良から生まれた癒やしのこころ②（出演：植物療法士・漢方養生指導士　橋本真季　氏）
description: 奈良で育まれた仏教や漢方は、変化が激しい現代を生きる私たちに多様な道標を示してくれます。令和3年に没後1400年を迎え、令和4年に御生誕1450年となる聖徳太子ゆかりの信貴山大本山玉蔵院の貫主と、奈良発祥とされる薬草の研究者のお話を通して、新年に向けて心を豊かにするヒントを探ります。

title: Healing Heart Born from Nara② (Featuring: Plant Therapist and Kampo Health Guidance Instructor Maki Hashimoto)
description: Buddhism and Kampo, nurtured in Nara, provide us with various signposts to navigate the rapidly changing modern world. Through the stories of the head priest of the Shigisan Daibonzan Gyokuzoin, which is associated with Prince Shotoku, who marks the 1400th anniversary of his death in 2021 and the 1450th anniversary of his birth in 2022, and a researcher of medicinal herbs said to have originated in Nara, we will explore hints to enrich our hearts as we approach the new year.

description: Matsuyama City faces the calm and beautiful Seto Inland Sea and has a warm climate with little rain throughout the year, making it a comfortable place to live. The western side of the city, which has excellent convenience, is by the sea, while the eastern side has mountains, combining the comfort of the city with the tranquility of the countryside. Additionally, it is rich in cultural attractions, being known as a city of 'hot springs, castles, and literature,' with the famous Dogo Onsen, said to be Japan's oldest hot spring, and the presence of Masaoka Shiki, who laid the foundation for modern haiku. At the center of the city stands Matsuyama Castle, which has a rare Edo-period keep, and the town that spreads at its foot is alive with the culture of a castle town. True to its history of welcoming pilgrims on the Shikoku pilgrimage, the spirit of warm hospitality is also alive here.

title: 青森県「深」探求プログラムPR動画
description: 教育現場では、問いを解く力から、問いを立てる力を身につける学習機会が必要とされており、 「課題設定能力」と「合意形成能力」を身につけることが求められています。このプログラムは、スタディツアーとワークショップで構成されます。 さまざまなテーマに沿ったスタディツアーでは、社会問題が起きている現場を訪問、地域の課題に触れるために施設や工場の解説付き見学、自ら体験してみる工芸品製作や、地域課題にについて関係者からお話を聞く講演を通じて、生徒たちが見て・聞いて・考える時間となるスタディツアー約3時間。そのスタディツアーで得た情報をもとに、少人数グループで議論を交わすワークショップ約3時間、まる一日がかりの学習日程です。 2泊3日や、3泊4日の修学旅行の1日を、このプログラムを体験する時間に費やしますので、生徒の身になる、価値ある時間を提供したいと考えています。

title: Aomori Prefecture 'Deep' Exploration Program PR Video
description: In the educational field, there is a need for learning opportunities that develop the ability to pose questions, as well as the ability to solve them. This program consists of study tours and workshops. The study tours, based on various themes, involve visiting sites where social issues are occurring, guided tours of facilities and factories to touch on local issues, hands-on experiences in craft production, and lectures from stakeholders about local challenges, providing students with about 3 hours to see, hear, and think. Based on the information gained from the study tours, students will engage in discussions in small groups during workshops for about 3 hours, making for a full day of learning. One day of a 2-night, 3-day or 3-night, 4-day school trip will be dedicated to experiencing this program, aiming to provide valuable time for students.

title: How to Make Kingyo Neputa
description: 弘前ねぷたは1722(享保7)年に初めて文献に登場してから、2022(令和4)年に300年という節目を迎えました。弘前ねぷた300年祭実行委員会では、弘前ねぷたの歴史と伝統の継承、そして未来へ繋げるため、『金魚ねぷたの作り方』動画を制作しました。

title: 【弘前城菊と紅葉まつり】FLOWER ART 2022_メイキング
description:
弘前城菊と紅葉まつりは、紅葉を楽しみ、お互いに育てた菊を持ち寄って品評会などをおこなっていた観楓会が発展し、昭和37年(1962)に「菊ともみじまつり」の名称で始まりました。今では、弘前公園の約1,000本の楓と約2,600本の桜が美しい紅葉を魅せる弘前の秋を象徴するまつりとして親しまれています。

2020年からは、「花」と「芸術」をキーワードに、ねぷたやりんごといった弘前ならではのシンボルと文化を融合させたフラワーアートが見どころのひとつとなっています。2022年のフラワーアートのテーマは「四季の華めき」。色彩豊かに変化してゆく弘前の春夏秋冬。楓と桜が織りなす紅葉の中に、花景家・阿部喜恵とねぷた師たちをはじめ、県内外の多くの方々との共創により、四季の自然と活力に溢れた津軽・弘前の姿を描きました。

title: 【Hirosaki Castle Chrysanthemum and Autumn Leaves Festival】FLOWER ART 2022_Making
description:
The Hirosaki Castle Chrysanthemum and Autumn Leaves Festival originated from the viewing parties that enjoyed autumn leaves and held chrysanthemum competitions, starting in 1962 under the name 'Chrysanthemum and Maple Festival'. Now, it is cherished as a festival symbolizing the beautiful autumn of Hirosaki, showcasing about 1,000 maple trees and approximately 2,600 cherry trees in Hirosaki Park.

Since 2020, one of the highlights has been flower art that merges Hirosaki's unique symbols and culture, such as nebuta and apples, with the keywords 'flower' and 'art'. The theme of the 2022 flower art was 'The Splendor of the Four Seasons'. It depicted the vibrant changes of Hirosaki's spring, summer, autumn, and winter, showcasing the natural beauty and vitality of Tsugaru and Hirosaki through collaborative efforts with many people, including flower artist Kie Abe and nebuta masters.

description: 1962年から続く、青森県弘前市の秋を象徴する「弘前城菊と紅葉まつり」。その中で、2020年からはじまった新しい展示企画が「花」と「芸術」をキーワードに、ねぷたやりんごといった弘前ならではのシンボルと文化を融合させたフラワーアートです。2020年は新型コロナウイルスの感染急拡大を受け中止となりましたが、その想いを引き継ぎ、今年は更に大きな作品制作に取り組みました。2021年のテーマは「枯木龍吟（こぼくりょうぎん）」。復活やさらなる発展へという想いが込められています。メイン作品となる「昇天華龍」は、全長１００ｍを超える大きさで、弘前のねぷた組師とフラワーアーティストの競演により制作されました。美しい弘前の紅葉と、様々な分野のアーティストと弘前市民の共作による作品群をご覧ください。

title: 【Hirosaki Castle Chrysanthemum and Autumn Leaves Festival】FLOWER ART 2021
description: The Hirosaki Castle Chrysanthemum and Autumn Leaves Festival, which has been held since 1962, symbolizes autumn in Hirosaki City, Aomori Prefecture. Among the events, a new exhibition project started in 2020, combining the keywords 'flowers' and 'art', fusing Hirosaki's unique symbols and culture such as nebuta and apples into flower art. The event was canceled in 2020 due to the rapid spread of COVID-19, but this year, we have taken on the challenge of creating even larger works, carrying on that spirit. The theme for 2021 is 'Koboku Ryogin', which embodies the desire for revival and further development. The main work, 'Shotenka Ryuu', is a giant dragon over 100 meters long, created in collaboration with Hirosaki's nebuta craftsmen and flower artists. Enjoy the beautiful autumn leaves of Hirosaki and the collaborative works of various artists and Hirosaki citizens.

title: ＼旬感！ 菊もみ！ 学生記者クラブ／

title: ＼旬感！ 菊もみ！ 学生記者クラブ／
description: From November 1 to November 7, the 'Hirosaki Castle Chrysanthemum and Autumn Leaves Festival' is being held at Hirosaki Park. Students from Hirosaki University have become reporters for the festival (commonly known as 'Kiku-Momi') and have conducted undercover coverage! We will deliver the production scenes of flower art and how to enjoy the festival. Some of you may have already visited? Although it's a bit late, this time we will deliver the order of appreciation to enjoy flower art more deeply. The dragon that came from the east passes through the East Gate and enters the Hirosaki Castle Botanical Garden. After passing through the flower arch, the dragon sits in the San-no-Maru Garden with a white flower on its head. The flower water represents the dragon's footprints. The apple tree towering next to the dragon bears red fruits filled with wishes. The flower water heading towards the Otemon from the apple tree overflows with apple leaves that have fallen from the tree, and a large apple is bearing fruit on the Otemon side of the San-no-Maru Garden. It has become like a story, but the story of the flower art 'Karaki Ryugin' progresses as follows: Hirosaki Castle Botanical Garden East Gate → Flower Arch → Flower Water → Ascending Dragon → Apple Wish Tree → Towards Otemon. Appreciating the story deepens the experience.

title: 【弘前城菊と紅葉まつり】～その先を、照らす。
description: 1962年から続く、青森県弘前の秋を象徴する「弘前城菊と紅葉まつり」。まつりの開催を4日後に控えた2020年10月19日、新型コロナウイルスの感染急拡大を受けその中止が決定されました。弘前四大まつりである、春のさくらまつり、夏のねぷたまつりに続く見送りです。秋のまつり・弘前城菊と紅葉まつりでは「継往開来／その先を、照らす。」をテーマに、弘前の歴史と文化から明るい未来を描いたメッセージを込めて、その準備が進められてきました。花から、人と人とをつなぐ。まつりは中止となりましたが、2020年の弘前の秋には、花と紅葉により豊かに彩られた弘前公園、未来へ向けた新たな挑戦、そこに関わる人々の姿がありました。動画をご覧になった方が少しでも元気に。弘前からのエールが、より多くの人に届きますように。

title: HIROSAKI CASTLE CHRYSANTHEMUM AND AUTUMN FOLIAGE FESTIVAL ～Lighting Up the Future.
description: Started in 1962, HIROSAKI CASTLE CHRYSANTHEMUM AND AUTUMN FOLIAGE FESTIVAL is an annual event that symbolizes the autumn of Hirosaki City, Aomori Pref. On October 19, 2020, four days before the Festival, the annual event was cancelled on account of the rapid spread of Covid-19. It was the third cancellation, after the spring cherry festival and the summer Nebuta festival, out of the four festivals of Hirosaki. The HIROSAKI CASTLE CHRYSANTHEMUM AND AUTUMN FOLIAGE FESTIVAL was meant to welcome the arrival of the season under the theme of “Lighting Up the Future.” It was to introduce the city’s history and traditions, and show the way to a brighter future. People Connected with Each Other under the Flowers. Although the festival was cancelled, the autumn of Hirosaki in 2020 saw the red and gold leaves and flowers in Hirosaki Park, and people involved in the event’s making with new challenges for the future. We send this video message to cheer you up, hoping that the greeting from Hirosaki reaches as many people as possible.

title: 旧弘前偕行社　紹介VTR
description: 旧弘前偕行社は、ルネサンス風様式を基調とした建物で、木造平屋建で簡明な洋風建築ですが、規模が大きく要所に配された華やかな細部意匠が特徴です。正面中央上部の屋根窓、軒廻りの持ち送り板、窓廻りの飾り枠や上部に付けた櫛形あるいは三角形の破風飾りなど、豊かな装飾を備えています。玄関廻りは、ポーチに鋳鉄柱を用い、車寄せの妻飾りとして唐草模様と陸軍第８師団に因んだ「蜂」のレリーフが印象的です。館内の大多数の窓ガラスは、気泡が入ったり波を打っておりレトロな雰囲気です。このほか、各部屋の漆喰天井の繊細な中心飾りは当時のままで、暖炉は外国製タイル（一部は欠損）が張られ洗練された意匠を配しています。旧弘前偕行社は、東北地方に残る陸軍関係施設の代表的遺構で陸軍省営繕組織による建築意匠の展開が示され、津軽を代表する棟梁が建築したことなど建築的な観点からも保存価値の高い建物です。終戦後、地域医療・福祉分野の先駆者であった故鳴海康仲氏の創設理念に基づき、弘前厚生学院の現校舎として次世代を担う人材育成を行う教育施設となって今もなお大切に活用されています。

title: Old Hirosaki Kaiko-sha Introduction VTR
description: The Old Hirosaki Kaiko-sha is a building based on Renaissance-style architecture, characterized by its large scale and the lavish details that are strategically placed throughout its simple wooden one-story structure. It features rich decorations such as the roof window at the center of the front, the supporting boards around the eaves, decorative frames around the windows, and the comb-shaped or triangular gable ornaments at the top. The entrance area is impressive with cast iron columns used in the porch and a relief of a 'bee' inspired by the 8th Army Division as a decorative element for the carport. Most of the window glass inside has bubbles and waves, giving it a retro atmosphere. Additionally, the delicate central decorations of the plaster ceilings in each room remain as they were at the time, and the fireplace is adorned with foreign tiles (some of which are missing) featuring sophisticated designs. The Old Hirosaki Kaiko-sha is a representative structure of military-related facilities remaining in the Tohoku region, demonstrating the architectural design developed by the Army Ministry's construction organization, and is a building of high preservation value from an architectural perspective, built by a master carpenter representing Tsugaru. After the war, based on the founding philosophy of the late Yasunaka Narumi, a pioneer in regional medical and welfare fields, it has been repurposed as the current campus of Hirosaki Kousei Gakuin, an educational facility that continues to nurture the next generation.

title: つかの桜街道
description: 国道７号の弘前市神田から津賀野地区には約２㎞にわたる桜並木があり、岩木山も一緒に眺められる絶景ポイントとなっています。４月末から５月上旬にかけて弘前のさくらは見頃を迎えます。桜の見頃は、毎年ゴールデンウィークにあたり、沢山の方々が県内外から訪れます。弘前のさくらは弘前公園だけではなく、国道７号沿いの「つかの桜街道」もおすすめですよ！ぜび見に来て下さいね！満開を迎える頃にはさくらの夜間ライトアップも行っています！ドライブに！お散歩に！国道７号の「つかの桜街道」はおすすめのスポットです！

title: Tsukano Sakura Street
description: There is a cherry blossom avenue along National Route 7, about 2 km from Kanda in Hirosaki City to the Tsugano area, where you can enjoy a spectacular view of Mount Iwaki. The cherry blossoms in Hirosaki reach their peak from late April to early May, coinciding with the Golden Week, attracting many visitors from both inside and outside the prefecture. The cherry blossoms in Hirosaki are not only at Hirosaki Park but also along the 'Tsukano Sakura Street' on National Route 7, which is highly recommended! Please come and see them! During the full bloom, there is also a night illumination of the cherry blossoms! It's a recommended spot for driving and walking along 'Tsukano Sakura Street' on National Route 7!

title: 弘前城石垣修理工事告知PR動画
description: 弘前市では、弘前城本丸東面の石垣修理工事に伴い、天守を約70ｍ本丸の内側へと曳屋する工事を平成27年に実施します。そのため、平成26年の秋頃には天守下の内濠を埋め立て、工事のための仮設基礎を設置する予定です。実際の天守の曳屋は、平成27年の夏頃を予定していますが、内濠の水面に映る天守と桜、水面に浮かぶ花筏といった、下乗橋からのおなじみの光景は、平成26年のさくらまつりを最後にしばらく見ることができません。石垣修理工事には約10年間を要し、曳屋した天守を元の位置に戻すまでにも5年以上かかると見込まれています。石垣修理は、史跡弘前城跡を保護し、後世に継承するため、避けて通ることのできない事業です。何卒、皆さまのご理解とご協力をお願いします。平成26年の春には、ぜひ多くの皆さまに弘前公園にお越し頂き、お城と桜を楽しんで頂ければと思います。

title: Hirosaki Castle Stone Wall Repair Work Announcement PR Video
description: In Hirosaki City, due to the stone wall repair work on the east side of the main keep of Hirosaki Castle, a construction to move the main keep about 70 meters inside the main enclosure will be carried out in 2015. Therefore, around autumn 2014, it is planned to fill in the inner moat under the main keep and set up a temporary foundation for the construction. The actual moving of the main keep is scheduled for the summer of 2015, but the familiar scenery of the main keep and cherry blossoms reflected on the surface of the inner moat, as well as the flower rafts floating on the water, will not be seen for a while after the cherry blossom festival in 2014. The stone wall repair work is expected to take about 10 years, and it is estimated that it will take more than 5 years to return the moved main keep to its original position. The stone wall repair is an unavoidable project to protect the historic site of Hirosaki Castle ruins and pass it on to future generations. We kindly ask for your understanding and cooperation. In the spring of 2014, we hope many of you will come to Hirosaki Park to enjoy the castle and cherry blossoms.

与論島に“光”を見に行く【観光】＝光を見る、と書く。では、“光”とは何か？与論島にはどんな“光”があるのだろう？珊瑚礁が作り上げた風景、史跡、食べ物、アクティビティ...観光映像を撮影するために与論島を訪れたドキュメンタリー映像作家・粂田剛が島中を歩き回りながら、さまざまな島の魅力に触れていく。そして、粂田が最終的に見つけた“光”とは、与論島で生きる“人”だった―――和歌山大学館工学部の木川剛志教授と共に、事前打ち合わせとしてZOOMで初回打ち合わせの際に、この与論島に光を見に行くというテーマが考えられていて、密着とキュメントを2名ほど想定され、その他島の人との出会いを中心に、徒歩で島を巡りながら撮影を進めるというドキュメンタリー作家ならではの手法で与論ファクトリーに臨むことになりました。合計、53名。島外の人5名。粂田監督が実際に取材し撮影した人数です。打ち合わせ時からできたら50名くらいは撮りたいなとおっしゃっていていましたが、1週間の日程で目標を達成されました。密着ドキュメンタリーには、2名男女が選ばれた。島人の高橋さんと、移住者の原さんに白羽の矢が当たり、当初予定していた「与論島に住んでいる人」の地域との関わり方や、与論島に魅了される人の眼差しにフォーカスした撮影が行なわれた。

title: Yoron Tourism Record Have you met the light in Yoron?
description:
Title: Yoron Tourism Record Have you met the light in Yoron? Director: Tsuyoshi Kumeda

Filming Locations: Throughout the town (Akazaki Beach, MEEDAFY’S YUI HOSTEL and COFFEE, Jinjya Shrine, etc.)

Going to Yoron Island to see the 'light'. What does 'light' mean? What kind of 'light' is there on Yoron Island? The documentary filmmaker Tsuyoshi Kumeda, who visited Yoron Island to shoot tourism videos, walked around the island and encountered various attractions of the island. Ultimately, the 'light' that Kumeda found was the 'people' living on Yoron Island. Together with Professor Tsuyoshi Kikawa from Wakayama University, the theme of going to see the light on Yoron Island was considered during the initial Zoom meeting for pre-arrangements, and it was planned to focus on two individuals for close documentation, while also meeting other islanders and filming while walking around the island, a method unique to documentary filmmakers. In total, 53 people were filmed, including 5 from outside the island. The number of people Kumeda interviewed and filmed was achieved within a week, aiming for about 50 people from the beginning. Two individuals were selected for the close documentary: Takahashi, a local islander, and Hara, a migrant, focusing on their relationship with the community and the perspectives of those captivated by Yoron Island.

title: 私のわいたんDAYS　ヨロン島
description:
作品名：私のわいたんDAYS ヨロン島
監督：景山 直恵
撮影編集：小川浩之
楽曲提供：アキラノスケ
ボーカル： yasuha

作品秘話
「ワイタンデー」＝「すごい！」「やばい！」などの感情を表す与論の方言を使用したタイトルで、作品の中で高校生たちがしきりに「やばい！やばい！」と思わず口に出していた感動の言葉を、島人に教えてもらった事をきっかけでタイトルにも採用しました。島外高校生が与論島の高校生と島を巡る旅「与論島の高校生が普段よく行く場所や、おすすめのポイントに連れて行ってもらう。ふたりがエモいと思う場所なども紹介。自分たちの暮らしや普段思うことの違いや共通点、これからのことやお互いの悩みなど、島外の高校生と与論島の高校生のリアルを語りながら与論島を案内する。」という企画内容を基に、事前に撮影許可を取得し、撮影に挑みました。
　景山監督は、元々グラフィックデザイナーであり、デザインコンサルを主な生業にされていますが、監督としては初の取り組みで、映像作家の小川氏とは仕事を依頼する側として繋がりがあり、お二人の感性を合わせた作品作りとなりました。

title: My Waitan Days: Yoron Island
description:
Title: My Waitan Days: Yoron Island
Director: Naoe Kageyama
Cinematography and Editing: Hiroyuki Ogawa
Music Provided by: Akiranosuke
Vocal: yasuha

Behind the Work
The title 'Waitan Days' uses a Yoron dialect that expresses emotions like 'amazing!' or 'incredible!' and was inspired by the emotional words 'yabai! yabai!' that high school students repeatedly exclaimed in the work, which they learned from the islanders. The project is based on a journey where high school students from outside the island are guided by Yoron Island high school students to places they often visit and recommend. It introduces places that both find emotional, discusses the differences and commonalities in their lives and thoughts, their future, and their worries, while guiding the island. The filming was conducted after obtaining permission in advance. Director Kageyama, originally a graphic designer and primarily a design consultant, took on this project for the first time as a director, collaborating with filmmaker Ogawa, with whom he had a working relationship as a client, resulting in a fusion of their sensibilities in the creation of this work.

title: 予期せぬ出会い～Unexpected Encounter～
description:
作品名：「Unexpected Encounter～予期せぬ出会い～」　

監督―― 宮田 耕輔
映像――反保シュウジ
写真――Eito Mars

撮影場所：
ウドノスビーチ・寺崎漁港・鳩の池・大金久海岸・サトウキビ畑・アジニッチェー神社・味咲・居酒屋やす　など

撮影秘話：
人に会いに行く島。
　宮田組一行は、3泊4日のスケジュールで初日の午後与論島に到着し、ゲストハウスKAIを拠点に撮影場所は実際に島を巡りながら、人の温かさに触れる旅を想定した企画を元に、「与論の人に出会う旅の中で、物書きの宮田氏が与論で感じ綴られた言葉と、Eito Mars氏が切り取った与論島の美しい情景、その旅の様子とまた別の視線で捉えた反保氏の映像がMIXされて作り出される観光映像」を制作するという内容で撮影を進めていきました。
　宮田組はレンタカーで島を巡りながら、ウドノスビーチで与論島産みずレモンを栽培している島人から、観光客があまり知らない夕日スポットを教えてもらって撮影したり、粂田監督の撮影にも協力を頂いていた肥田みちよさんが行っているテントサウナを体験したり、朝日のシーンを撮影に訪れた鳩の池では、三線と法螺貝で観光客をもてなす島人に出会うなど、与論の人の出会いが繋がりながら、撮影がすすめられました。その島の人との出会いの体験を元に、実際に宮田監督が紡いだ文章が作品内で使用されるテロップに流れ、その心象風景を納めたスチールカメラの写真と実写が映し出される映像作品として仕上がりました。

title: Unexpected Encounter～予期せぬ出会い～
description:
Title: "Unexpected Encounter～予期せぬ出会い～"

Director: Kousuke Miyata
Visual: Shuji Hanbo
Photography: Eito Mars

Filming Locations:
Udonos Beach, Terasaki Fishing Port, Hato Pond, Okkinuku Coast, Sugarcane Fields, Ajinichie Shrine, Ajisaki, Izakaya Yasu, etc.

Filming Anecdote:
A journey to meet people on the island.
The Miyata crew arrived on Yoron Island on the afternoon of the first day with a 3-night, 4-day schedule, using Guest House KAI as a base. The filming locations were planned to be explored while experiencing the warmth of the people. The project aimed to create a tourism video that mixes the words written by writer Miyata, who felt and expressed his experiences on Yoron, the beautiful scenery of Yoron Island captured by Eito Mars, and the footage taken from a different perspective by Shuji Hanbo. The crew traveled around the island by rental car, capturing moments such as meeting islanders cultivating Yoron Island's water lemons at Udonos Beach, discovering sunset spots unknown to tourists, experiencing a tent sauna run by Michiyo Hida, who also assisted in the filming of Director Kumeda, and encountering islanders welcoming tourists with sanshin and conch shells at Hato Pond during a sunrise shoot. The filming progressed as connections with the people of Yoron were made. Based on these experiences, the text woven by Director Miyata was used in the subtitles of the work, culminating in a video piece that showcases both still photographs and live-action footage of the imagined landscapes.

description:

Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/yoron_island_official/

Okinawa's northern area was designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2021. The forests of Yanbaru in northern Okinawa are home to lush greenery, clear flowing waters, and numerous rare plants and animals.

About 2 hours by ferry from Motobu Port in northern Okinawa lies Yoron Island, a 'tropical paradise' boasting beautiful blue seas.

Yoron Island features the stunning YORON BLUE sea and various marine leisure activities to enjoy. In addition to the sea, the island offers history, local culture, delicious food, and unforgettable encounters with the island's people, creating lasting travel memories. Whether with friends, as a couple, or with family, the beautiful sea and kind people of this island are always waiting for you.

The greenery of Yanbaru in Okinawa and the beautiful blue sea of Yoron Island. The two different charms spread across the sea are connected by a ferry, delivering a unique tourism experience.

description: 沖縄北部エリアは2021年に世界自然遺産に認定されました。沖縄北部のやんばるの森には、美しく生い茂る緑豊かな森や、清らかな水の流れ、数多くの希少な動植物が生息します。沖縄北部の本部港からフェリーで約2時間、美しい青い海を誇る「南国の楽園 ヨロン島」があります。ヨロン島には美しく青く輝くYORON BLUEの海、そしてそれを楽しむ様々なマリンレジャーがあります。また、海だけでなく、歴史や郷土文化、美味しい食事、そして島の人々との出会いが忘れられない旅の思い出を作ります。友達と一緒に、カップルでも、ファミリーでも、この島の美しい海と優しい人々は、いつでもあなたを待っています。沖縄のやんばるの緑と、ヨロン島の美しい海のブルー。海を挟んで広がる異なる2つの魅力はフェリーで繋がり、1つの特別な観光体験をお届けします。

title: ♭ヨロン
description: 監督 楠の目に映った与論島の人と文化をライター村上美香が詩に落とし込み、CM音楽プロデューサー福島節の作った楽曲を与論島民の竹下千帆さんに歌ってもらい、与論島にはじめて訪れた旅人役 福島真希の心の変化を描いた作品です。本作は楠が与論島で体験した「おかえりなさい文化」を主軸に企画しました。実際に「おかえりなさい文化」という言葉などありませんが、与論島民の根底には「わざわざ遠い島まで来てくれてありがとう」という来島者への感謝や敬意が込められており、それが来島者を「おかえりなさい」という言葉として迎え入れる理由だと聞きました。場所ではなく人に会いに行く観光地なんだ、と気付かされた与論島ならではの温度感を描写した作品です。

title: ♭Yoron
description: This work depicts the changes in the heart of the traveler, played by Maki Fukushima, who visited Yoron Island for the first time, with the culture and people of Yoron Island reflected through the eyes of director Kenta Kusunoki, and the song created by music producer Setsu Fukushima sung by Chihiro Takeshita, a resident of Yoron Island. The project was centered around the 'Welcome Back Culture' that Kusunoki experienced on Yoron Island. Although the term 'Welcome Back Culture' does not actually exist, it is said that the essence of the Yoron Islanders is filled with gratitude and respect for visitors who have come all the way to the distant island, which is the reason they welcome visitors with the words 'Welcome Back.' This work captures the unique warmth of Yoron Island, which made me realize that it is a tourist destination to meet people rather than places.

description: May there be a place for you that feels like a warm bath you can soak in forever, here in Minami Aso. At the southern foot of Mount Aso in Kumamoto, there are many unique hot springs with various mineral qualities. The Minami Aso Onsen District 'Gogaku Gotou' is a phrase used by the hot spring guardians, likening the five hot spring groups that spring forth in this area to the five mountains that have watched over Aso since it was still a lake. Would you like to immerse yourself in pure happiness in this wonderful countryside?

description:
【🍧Summer tradition 'Gentle Ice Project of Minami Aso 2023' Part 1🍧】

Today, July 15 (Saturday), the Minami Aso Railway will fully reopen, and the 'KIOKU' experience and exhibition facility of the Kumamoto Earthquake Disaster Museum will also open, making this summer more noteworthy than ever for Minami Aso.

Starting in 2019, the summer event 'Gentle Ice Project of Minami Aso' has become a summer tradition, now in its fifth year. This year, it will be held in two parts: Part 1 and Part 2!
First, starting from July 15 (Saturday), Part 1 'Welcome Back! Minami Aso Railway Campaign' will begin! Those who eat shaved ice at participating stores will receive a limited edition 'Minami Aso Railway Full Line Reopening Commemorative Coaster' in collaboration with the Minami Aso Railway! This is available in limited quantities and will end as soon as they run out, so please come early!
(Distribution will start sequentially from July 15. Please note that the distribution start period may vary by store.)

Part 2 will start on July 22 (Saturday)! This year, we will distribute a shaved ice map! The 'Gentle Ice of Minami Aso' made with carefully selected ingredients is exquisite! This year, the number of participating stores has increased from 9 to a total of 10!
Of course, Part 2 is not just this! More details will be announced soon!
(The shaved ice map will start being distributed from July 22 at participating stores and tourist information centers. Map data can be checked from July 15 at the link below.)
https://minamiaso.info/blog/kakigori2023/

On hot days, why not come to Minami Aso to cool down with the proud shaved ice from each store? We look forward to your visit.

title: Gentle Ice of Minami Aso 2023 [Campaign Part 1]
description:
【🍧夏の風物詩「南阿蘇のやさしい氷プロジェクト2023」第1弾🍧】

本日7月15日（土）に南阿蘇鉄道全線開通や熊本地震震災ミュージアム体験・展示施設の「KIOKU」がオープンすることもあり今年の夏は今まで以上に注目の南阿蘇です。

2019年に始まり、今年で5年目を迎える夏の風物詩となった夏期イベントの「南阿蘇のやさしい氷プロジェクト」が始動。今年は、第1弾・第2弾の2部構成！
まずは７月１５日（土）より第1弾「おかえり！南阿蘇鉄道キャンペーン」がスタートします！

title: 南阿蘇村PV 2022 -Minamiaso Village PV 2022-
description: Minamiaso Village is a 'hometown of water' that spreads at the southern foot of the Aso caldera, which boasts one of the largest areas in the world. It is full of unique attractions that can only be experienced here, such as rich agricultural products nurtured by spring water and its blessings, the Minamiaso Railway running through rural landscapes, abundant hot springs with various water qualities, and the grasslands that have been used as grazing land for over a thousand years, along with the Akaushi cattle that live there. We hope you will visit Minamiaso Village and experience this 360° breathtaking scenery with your own senses.

title: 【VR】南阿蘇 空から見た一心行の大桜360°
description:
■Isshingyo no Ozakura

Surrounded by a carpet of rapeseed flowers, this 400-year-old cherry tree stands alone.

With an age of about 400 years, a height of 14m, a spread of 21.3m east-west and 26m north-south, and a trunk circumference of 7.35m, this great cherry tree (Yamazakura) is a symbol of Minami Aso Village, blooming with pale pink flowers. During full bloom, limited-time illuminations are held, allowing visitors to enjoy the fantastical scenery of rapeseed flowers and cherry blossoms.

Blooming period: Late March to early April

title: 熊本県南阿蘇村ふるさと納税・返礼品PRムービー　15秒ver.
description: 「世界一のカルデラの村から、あなたへ。」熊本県・南阿蘇村。世界最大級の大きさを誇る阿蘇カルデラの南麗にあるのどかな農村です。環境庁の日本名水百選に選定されている白川水源をはじめとする湧水群があり、「水の生まれる郷」として湧水が村民の暮らしに豊かな恩恵をもたらしています。カルデラの中に人が暮らし、鉄道まで走っているのは非常に珍しく“世界一のカルデラの村”として観光地にもなっています。田園広がる絶景のパノラマや、豊かな湧水で作られる美味しい野菜やお米、そして阿蘇の草原でのんびりと育つあか牛…決して豪華ではありませんが、どれも自然の恵みと村人の愛情がこもった逸品ばかり。世界一のカルデラの村からあなたへ、ふるさと納税で贈り物をお届けいたします。

title: Kumamoto Prefecture Minami Aso Village Furusato Tax Return Gift PR Movie 15 seconds version
description: From the world's number one caldera village, to you. Minami Aso Village in Kumamoto Prefecture. A peaceful rural village located on the southern slope of the Aso caldera, which boasts one of the largest sizes in the world. It has a group of spring water, including the Shirakawa water source, which has been selected as one of Japan's top 100 famous waters by the Ministry of the Environment, providing rich benefits to the lives of the villagers as a 'hometown of water.' It is very rare for people to live within a caldera and for a railway to run there, making it a tourist destination known as the 'world's number one caldera village.' With breathtaking panoramic views of sprawling fields, delicious vegetables and rice made from rich spring water, and the relaxed raising of Akabuu in the Aso grasslands... Although not luxurious, each item is filled with the blessings of nature and the love of the villagers. We deliver gifts through furusato tax from the world's number one caldera village to you.

title: 熊本県南阿蘇村ふるさと納税・返礼品PRムービー「南阿蘇TEA HOUSE」
description:
Kumamoto Prefecture Minami-Aso Village born herb tea specialty store 'Minami-Aso TEA HOUSE'. Under the gentle sunlight of the Aso mountains, we cultivate herbs in rich nature and handle carefully selected herbs from around the world, blending all of them in-house.

With good water and soil, gentle sunlight, and pleasant winds, Kumamoto Prefecture Minami-Aso Village provides wonderful conditions for herbs. By carefully nurturing them, we bring out the power of herbs, resulting in fragrant and delicious herbal teas.
* No pesticides or chemical fertilizers are used. They are cultivated in safe farmland certified by JAS.

熊本県南阿蘇村ふるさと納税・返礼品PRムービー「宮﨑製茶のお茶」
description: 南阿蘇・下野地区にある「南阿蘇・宮崎製茶」は、昭和27年に創業した老舗の製茶工場。その三代目、宮崎さん。先代から受け継いだ3ヘクタールの茶畑で、玉緑茶・粉末緑茶、ほうじ茶を作っています。さらに平成23年には、村内で唯一となる紅茶の製造も開始しました。宮崎製茶工場自慢のお茶は、すべて宮崎さん自らがほぼお一人で作っています。茶葉の刈り取りから乾燥、発酵など、完成までのいくつもの工程がありますが、苦労もなんのその。楽しみながらお茶づくりに励んでいます。「宮崎製茶工場」宮崎さんが作る自慢のお茶、是非一度ご賞味ください。

title: Kumamoto Prefecture Minami-Aso Village Furusato Tax Return Gift PR Movie 'Miyazaki Tea'
description: Minami-Aso, Shimono area 'Minami-Aso Miyazaki Tea' is a long-established tea factory founded in 1952. The third generation, Mr. Miyazaki, produces gyokuro, powdered green tea, and hojicha in a 3-hectare tea field inherited from his predecessor. In addition, in 2011, he started producing black tea, the only one in the village. All of the tea that Miyazaki Tea Factory is proud of is made almost entirely by Mr. Miyazaki himself. There are many processes from harvesting tea leaves to drying and fermentation, but despite the hardships, he enjoys making tea. Please try the proud tea made by Mr. Miyazaki at 'Miyazaki Tea Factory' at least once.

title: 熊本県南阿蘇村ふるさと納税・返礼品PRムービー「オーガニック野菜のベビーフード」
description:
The 'Kuchidoke' series of baby food, popular as a return gift from Minami-Aso Village. Supervised by a nutritionist, this baby food is safe and secure, used in obstetrics and gynecology clinics. It all started with a request from a famous obstetrics and gynecology clinic to create baby food. It is made with the supervision of a nutritionist and in consultation with specialists, ensuring safety and security like no other. It is still handled by a famous obstetrics and gynecology clinic and loved by many parents and children.

Minami-Aso Organic, which produces the 'Kuchidoke' series, originally cultivated cosmetics and herbs for over 10 years. They are particularly focused on providing babies with the safest and most secure products from the very beginning.

title: 熊本県南阿蘇村ふるさと納税・返礼品PRムービー「こだわりのお酒」
description: 良質な水や米でなければ良質なお酒はできない、そんな想いから作られた南阿蘇村のお酒をご紹介します。「水の国」熊本県の南阿蘇村は、豊かな湧水の宝庫で「日本の名水百選」にも選ばれるほど良質な水に恵まれています。そんなミネラルたっぷりの湧水と、栽培期間中農薬や肥料を使わずに作った旨味たっぷりの酒米を使用したお酒は、まろやかな飲み心地と芳醇な香りを感じられます。清酒や米焼酎、キリっとした辛口やほどよい甘みのあるものなど、特徴の違ったお酒が豊富にあるのも美味しいお米と水が豊かな熊本のお酒ならでは。南阿蘇村の自慢のお酒、ぜひ一度お試しください。

title: Kumamoto Prefecture Minami-Aso Village Furusato Tax Donation and Return Gift PR Movie 'Carefully Selected Sake'
description: Introducing the sake of Minami-Aso Village, created with the belief that good sake cannot be made without good water and rice. Minami-Aso Village in Kumamoto Prefecture, known as the 'Land of Water,' is blessed with high-quality water that has been selected as one of Japan's 100 Famous Waters. The sake made from this mineral-rich spring water and sake rice grown without pesticides or fertilizers during the cultivation period offers a smooth drinking experience and rich aroma. The variety of sake available, including junmai sake, rice shochu, crisp dry types, and those with moderate sweetness, is unique to Kumamoto, where delicious rice and water abound. We invite you to try the pride of Minami-Aso Village's sake.

title: 熊本県南阿蘇村ふるさと納税・返礼品PRムービー「南阿蘇の水」編
description: The Aso region, which has one of the world's largest calderas, is a treasure trove of natural water sources, with the blessings of Aso Mountain's abundant natural water. Minami-Aso has 11 water sources, among which the Shirakawa Water Source is the most representative, gushing out 60 tons of water per minute, containing a moderate amount of minerals. The water that springs from the Shirakawa Water Source and other spring groups nourishes the rice fields and farms of Minami-Aso Village, allowing delicious rice, vegetables, and fruits to grow. The water from the Shirakawa Water Source is delivered in its original deliciousness as moderately mineralized soft water through non-heating processing.

title: 熊本県南阿蘇村ふるさと納税・返礼品PRムービー「南阿蘇菓舗・古今堂」編
description: The fresh cheese bun 1592 is a fresh cheese bun filled with a heartfelt commitment to the selection of ingredients. The raw material for the cheese filling is ASOMILK from Abe Farm. In 2013, it received the Three Stars award from the International Taste Institute, being the first in Japan for milk. Starting with making homemade cream cheese at our own factory using ASOMILK, we also select wheat grown with Kumamoto's underground water for other ingredients. We pursued a unique manufacturing method to achieve a moist and melting texture in the mouth, reminiscent of fresh caramel. The name "1592" comes from the elevation of Mount Aso in Kumamoto, which is 1592 meters (Takadake), and is named after the Higo region. It can be enjoyed chilled or frozen.

title: 熊本県南阿蘇村ふるさと納税・返礼品PRムービー「南阿蘇のお米」編
description: 世界最大級のカルデラが広がる熊本・阿蘇。そこには脈々と流れるミネラル豊富な湧水があり、そしてその全てを吸収してすくすくと育った栄養たっぷりのお米が育ちます。昼夜の寒暖差が激しい阿蘇の気候と、澄んだ空気、清らかな湧水によって、旨味をギュッと蓄えたお米になり、甘みは格別です。南阿蘇村では、農薬・除草剤などを最大限に減らす為に優しいアイガモ農法を取り入れ、またJAS有機認定の優しい肥料のみを使用するなど、安心・安全面でもこだわり抜いたお米作りも盛んです。全国的に人気が高い「コシヒカリ」も南阿蘇村産のお米の中ではとても人気で、一粒一粒を噛むごとにモチモチした触感とお米本来の甘さが感じられます。この「コシヒカリ」は炊きたてはもちろんですが、冷めても美味しく食べられるので、お弁当に入れるご飯としても非常におすすめのお米です。農家の優しい愛情が感じられる旨味たっぷりのお米を、ぜひ一度ご賞味ください。

title: Kumamoto Prefecture Minami-Aso Village Furusato Tax Return Gift PR Movie 'Minami-Aso Rice' Edition
description: Kumamoto and Aso, where the world's largest caldera spreads. There is mineral-rich spring water flowing through it, and the nutritious rice that has absorbed all of it grows vigorously. The climate of Aso, with its significant temperature difference between day and night, clear air, and pure spring water, creates rice that is packed with flavor and has exceptional sweetness. In Minami-Aso Village, they adopt a gentle duck farming method to minimize the use of pesticides and herbicides, and they are also actively engaged in rice cultivation that is committed to safety and security by using only gentle fertilizers certified by JAS organic. The nationally popular 'Koshihikari' is also very popular among the rice produced in Minami-Aso Village, and with each grain you chew, you can feel the chewy texture and the inherent sweetness of the rice. This 'Koshihikari' is delicious not only when freshly cooked but also when cooled, making it highly recommended for inclusion in bento boxes. Please enjoy the flavorful rice that reflects the gentle love of the farmers.

title: 【南阿蘇サイクルラリー】自転車でクイズラリーに挑戦しよう！
description: 南阿蘇の各スポットに設定されたラリー地点を電動自転車（e-bike）でめぐり、クイズの答えを探しながら自由に楽しむサイクリング！ラリー地点は全部で11箇所（阿蘇山上も！）と、広～い南阿蘇に点在しています。獲得ポイントに応じてランクを認定！最高位の称号『ミナミアソ教授』を目指して何度もチャレンジしよう！

title: Minami Aso Cycle Rally: Let's Challenge the Quiz Rally by Bicycle!
description: The Minami Aso Cycle Rally is a cycling event where you can freely enjoy riding an electric bicycle (e-bike) while searching for answers to quizzes at rally points set up at various spots in Minami Aso! There are a total of 11 rally points (including the top of Mount Aso) scattered across the vast Minami Aso area. You will be ranked based on the points you earn! Challenge yourself multiple times to aim for the highest title, 'Minami Aso Professor'!

title: 新阿蘇大橋 開通直前企画『復興への光の架け橋』
description: 2021年3月7日、熊本地震で崩落した阿蘇大橋が「新阿蘇大橋」として生まれ変わり、ついに開通します。 その直前企画として、新阿蘇大橋とその展望所のライトアップ『復興への光の架け橋』が実施されました。こちらはその記録動画です。 新阿蘇大橋が「熊本と阿蘇をつなぐ架け橋」「復興した未来へとつながる架け橋」「人と人とをつなぐ架け橋」のシンボルになればという願いが込められています。 ＜復興への光の架け橋＞ 期間：2021年1月15日(金)～2月21日(日) 18:00～ 内容：新阿蘇大橋と数鹿流崩之碑展望所の装飾 企画：新阿蘇大橋活性化協議会 協力：立野わかもん会 ※実施に際して、新阿蘇大橋施工業者の方にもご協力いただいています。ありがとうございます。 撮影・編集 Hub.craft

title: New Aso Bridge Opening Just Before Project 'Bridge of Light to Reconstruction'
description: On March 7, 2021, the Aso Bridge, which collapsed due to the Kumamoto earthquake, will be reborn as the 'New Aso Bridge' and will finally open. As a pre-opening project, the lighting up of the New Aso Bridge and its observation point, 'Bridge of Light to Reconstruction', was carried out. This is a recorded video of that event. It is hoped that the New Aso Bridge will become a symbol of 'a bridge connecting Kumamoto and Aso', 'a bridge leading to a reconstructed future', and 'a bridge connecting people'. <Bridge of Light to Reconstruction> Period: January 15, 2021 (Friday) to February 21, 2021 (Sunday) from 18:00 Content: Decoration of the New Aso Bridge and the Kazurakuryu Collapse Monument Observation Point Planning: New Aso Bridge Activation Council Cooperation: Tateno Wakamon Association *We would like to thank the contractors of the New Aso Bridge for their cooperation in this implementation. Shooting and editing by Hub.craft.

title: 新阿蘇大橋開通日発表！！カウントダウン看板「たぶん」→「あと」差し替え！！
description: 2021年2月2日、ついに新阿蘇大橋（仮称）の開通日が発表されました！開通日は【2021年3月7日（日）15時】です！「道の駅あそ望の郷くぎの」には、新阿蘇大橋開通までの日数をカウントダウンするパネルがあります。これまでは、開通日が確定していなかったために、不確定であるという意味の「たぶん」を添えていました。みなみあそ観光局スタッフが、毎日毎日「たぶん」とついたカウントダウンパネルをめくり、首を長くして待ち焦がれたこの日。ようやく「たぶん」が「あと」になりました！スタッフの喜びあふれる様子をご覧ください。

title: Announcement of the Opening Date of the New Aso Ohashi!! Countdown Signboard Changed from 'Probably' to 'Remaining'!!
description: On February 2, 2021, the opening date of the new Aso Ohashi (tentative name) was finally announced! The opening date is 【March 7, 2021 (Sunday) at 15:00】! At 'Roadside Station Aso No Sato Kugino', there is a panel counting down the days until the opening of the new Aso Ohashi. Until now, the panel had the word 'probably' attached, as the opening date was not confirmed. The staff of Minami Aso Tourism Bureau turned the countdown panel every day, eagerly waiting for this day. Finally, 'probably' has changed to 'remaining'! Please take a look at the staff's overflowing joy.

title: 【南阿蘇サイクリング】モデルコース④「阿蘇山頂チャレンジコース」
description:

草千里だけでなく火口も立ち寄ってみてはいかがでしょうか？

title: 2020年10月3日 国道57号（現道）開通
description:
国道57号線 立野区間 （通称:立野キャニオンロード）

遥か昔、健磐龍命が蹴破り阿蘇を拓いた伝説が残る立野峡谷。その壮大な景観を望みながら阿蘇へと続く国道57号線は、地元では“立野キャニオンロード”と呼ば親しまれてきました。
2016年熊本地震の大規模斜面崩落(数鹿流くずれ)により寸断されていたが、約4年半の時を経て2020年10月3日に開通します。

title: Opening of National Route 57 (Current Road) on October 3, 2020
description:
National Route 57 Line, the Tateyano section (commonly known as Tateyano Canyon Road)

Long ago, there is a legend that the deity Kenbanryu no Mikoto broke through and developed Aso in the Tateyano Gorge. The National Route 57 line, which continues to Aso while overlooking its magnificent scenery, has been affectionately called 'Tateyano Canyon Road' by locals. It was cut off due to a large-scale landslide (Suzukaryu collapse) caused by the Kumamoto earthquake in 2016, but it will open on October 3, 2020, after about four and a half years.

title: 【南阿蘇】レンタサイクルに乗ろう！絶景ロードを走って白川水源までver.
description: 【レンタサイクルに乗ろう！絶景ロードを走って白川水源までver.】南阿蘇の一番人気のアクティビティ、レンタサイクルの動画をご紹介！快適な電動アシスト付自転車にまたがり、雄大な阿蘇の大パノラマを感じながら白川水源まで。観光案内所スタッフのオススメコース、一本道の田園風景を走る「絶景ロード」や南阿蘇鉄道沿線沿いを走る「トレインロード」など地元に住むコーディネーターだからそこ知る南阿蘇を満喫できるスペシャルコースとなっています。車の通りも少ない田舎道を選び、なるべく安全なコース設定となっています。今回の目的地である「白川水源」は熊本を代表する南阿蘇湧水群の代名詞とも言える水源で一級河川白川の総水源。毎分60トンもの湧水が地底の砂とともに勢いよく湧き上がり、訪れる人々に大地の恵みを感じさせます。南阿蘇観光案内所ではe-sports bike（電動クロスバイク）、ママチャリ自転車(電動アシスト付)、子供用マウンテンバイク（※電動アシストなし）など様々な年齢に対応した自転車をご用意しております。南阿蘇に訪れた際は是非、ご利用ください。レンタサイクル料金などはみなみあそ観光局HPをご覧ください。

title: Let's Ride a Rental Bicycle in Minami Aso! Running on the Scenic Road to Shirakawa Springs ver.
description: This video introduces the most popular activity in Minami Aso, rental cycling! Hop on a comfortable electric assist bicycle and feel the magnificent panorama of Aso while heading to Shirakawa Springs. The recommended courses by the staff at the tourist information center include the 'Scenic Road' that runs through the picturesque rural landscape and the 'Train Road' along the Minami Aso Railway, making it a special course that allows you to fully enjoy Minami Aso, known by local coordinators. The course is set to be as safe as possible, choosing country roads with little traffic. The destination, 'Shirakawa Springs,' is a representative water source of Kumamoto, known as the symbol of the Minami Aso spring water group, and is the total water source of the first-class river Shirakawa. Every minute, 60 tons of spring water gushes up vigorously along with the underground sand, allowing visitors to feel the blessings of the earth. The Minami Aso Tourist Information Center offers various bicycles suitable for different ages, including e-sports bikes (electric cross bikes), mama-chari bicycles (with electric assist), and children's mountain bikes (without electric assist). If you visit Minami Aso, please make sure to use them. For rental bicycle fees and more, please check the Minami Aso Tourism Bureau website.

title: 東海大学農学部を卒業する皆さんへ～2020年 春～
description:
～東海大学農学部を卒業される皆様へ～

大学ご卒業おめでとうございます。

4年間の密度の濃い大学生活を経て、これから社会人としてそれぞれの道へと進むべく、皆様の心は今、期待や不安、そして覚悟でいっぱいかと存じます。

入学直後には熊本地震があり、皆様に大変な思いをさせてしまったことを申し訳なく思います。それでも若い皆さんが少しでも住んでくれて、またキャンパスが移った後も南阿蘇に関わってくれて、本当に嬉しかったです。

今回、残念ながら新型コロナの影響で卒業式も中止となり、別れを惜しむ時間も取れないまま見送ることとなってしまい、大変無念な気持ちでおります。そこで、皆様に向けたせめてものエールとして、南阿蘇村一同からお祝いと感謝の気持ちを込めたメッセージ動画をお届けします。南阿蘇村には皆様の居場所がいつでもあります。立派になった皆さんとまたお会いできる日を楽しみにしています。

夢に向かって元気に羽ばたく皆様のご多幸を心より祈念いたします。

title: To All Graduates of Tokai University Faculty of Agriculture - Spring 2020
description:
Congratulations on your graduation from university.

After four years of a dense university life, I believe your hearts are now filled with expectations, anxieties, and determination as you each embark on your respective paths as members of society.

I sincerely apologize for the difficulties you faced due to the Kumamoto earthquake shortly after your enrollment. Nevertheless, I was truly happy that you young people lived here even a little, and that you continued to be involved with Minami Aso after the campus moved.

Unfortunately, due to the impact of the new coronavirus, the graduation ceremony has been canceled, and we have had to send you off without the time to bid farewell, which is very regrettable. Therefore, as a small token of encouragement for you, we are delivering a message video filled with congratulations and gratitude from all of Minami Aso Village. There will always be a place for you in Minami Aso Village. We look forward to the day we can meet again with all of you who have become wonderful individuals.

I sincerely wish for your happiness as you energetically spread your wings toward your dreams.

title: 第8回 南阿蘇スターライトイルミネーション 点灯式
description: 「南阿蘇ラブチェアー＆イルミネーション」公式HP ⇒ https://minamiaso.love/ 南阿蘇の冬のシンボル「南阿蘇スターライトイルミネーション」。第8回目は2019年11月16日（土）に点灯式を開催しました。当日はイルミネーションの点火に加えて、日中はラブチェアー作成ワークショップ、福岡消防音楽隊有志による演奏。夜には南阿蘇エリアの小中学生と作成した700個の灯篭も「ありがとう みなみあそ」のメッセージと共に点灯し、熱気球体験も開催しました。イルミネーションは2020年2月16日（日）まで、毎日午後5時～9時まで点灯いたします。

title: 8th Minami Aso Starlight Illumination Lighting Ceremony
description: Official HP of 'Minami Aso Love Chair & Illumination' ⇒ https://minamiaso.love/ The winter symbol of Minami Aso, 'Minami Aso Starlight Illumination'. The 8th event was held on November 16, 2019 (Saturday) with a lighting ceremony. In addition to the illumination lighting, there was a love chair creation workshop during the day, and a performance by members of the Fukuoka Fire Department Music Band. At night, 700 lanterns created by elementary and junior high school students in the Minami Aso area were lit with the message 'Thank you Minami Aso', and a hot air balloon experience was also held. The illumination will be lit every day from 5 PM to 9 PM until February 16, 2020 (Sunday).

在地紀錄片【鄉野中的日本】EP03 | 與飛騨高山一站之隔，謝絕打卡遊客的山間古鎮 | 岐阜縣飛騨古川
description: 世界的に有名な飛驒高山と比べて、わずか一駅の距離にある飛騨古川は、静かに存在している場所です。同じく世界無形文化遺産である古川祭を持つ古川町は、観光客に彼らの穏やかな生活を邪魔されたくないようです。白壁土蔵の古い町並みがあるにもかかわらず、ここに住む人々は古い生業を続けています。

title: Documentary in the Countryside: Japan EP03 | A Mountain Town Refusing Check-in Tourists, Just One Stop from Takayama | Gifu Prefecture Hida Furukawa
description: Compared to the world-renowned Takayama, Hida Furukawa, just one stop away, is a quietly existing place. The town of Furukawa, which also has the world intangible cultural heritage of the Furukawa Festival, seems reluctant to be disturbed by tourists in their leisurely lives. Despite the charm of the old town with its white-walled storehouses, the locals continue their ancient livelihoods.

title: 福島，並不是你印象中的荒地！這裡有藝術，有回憶，有未來 | 福島縣耶麻郡西會津 | 在地紀錄片【鄉野中的日本】EP02
description: 福島、一個談之色變的地名。因勉強還能維持生活，使得人口老化問題遲遲不受到重視。直到2011東日本大震災敲響了警鐘，讓在地年輕人意識到變革勢在必行。

title: Fukushima, Not the Wasteland You Imagine! Here There is Art, Memories, and a Future | Nishiaizu, Yamagata Prefecture | Local Documentary [Japan in the Countryside] EP02
description: Fukushima, a name that evokes fear. Due to the ability to barely maintain a living, the issue of an aging population has long been overlooked. It wasn't until the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake sounded the alarm that local youth realized that change was imperative.

title: 在地紀錄片【鄉野中的日本】EP01 | 修驗道行者隱居深山打造完美治愈空間 | 奈良縣宇陀市深野
description: 今回の巡旅君が訪れたのは、奈良県宇陀市深野にある「笹百合庵」です。松林哲司先生は、特異な人生経験を持つ人物で、大学時代に一人で世界を旅し、ヒマラヤ山脈の神秘に魅了されながらも、大阪で商社を経営していました。その後、理想の精神世界を追求するために修験道の僧侶となり、深山の村にある百年の古民家を改造し、ここで修行し、ビジネスを行い、世界中の旅人を迎え入れています。彼が追い求めるものは、現代の都市生活に奔走する人々が体験する土地と居住空間の一体どのようなものでしょうか？

title: Documentary in the Countryside: Japan EP01 | 修験道行者が深山に隠れ家を作り出す完璧な癒しの空間 | 奈良県宇陀市深野
description: This time, the traveler visits 'Sasayuri-an' located in Fukano, Uda City, Nara Prefecture, founded by a practitioner of Shugendo, Mr. Tetsuji Matsubayashi. Mr. Matsubayashi is a person with a unique life experience, having traveled the world alone during his university days. Although he was captivated by the mystery and solemnity of the Himalayas, he eventually returned to his hometown to run a trading company in Osaka. Later, in pursuit of his ideal spiritual world, he became a Shugendo monk, transforming a century-old house in a mountain village to practice, conduct business, and host travelers from around the world. What kind of land and living space is he seeking, which he also hopes modern urban dwellers can experience?

title: 冬いく！冬うく！宇久島冬動画！
description: 冬は離島に行ってもやることがない？いやいや実は冬の宇久島こそ島の醍醐味を味わえるんですよ！寒い時期しか楽しめない島の魅力が目いっぱい詰まった冬動画をお届けします！

title: Winter is Coming! Winter Fun on Ukushima Island!
description: Is there nothing to do even if you go to an island in winter? No, actually, winter is when you can truly enjoy the charm of Ukushima Island! We deliver a winter video packed with the island's attractions that can only be enjoyed in the cold season!

title: 五島列島最北端「宇久島」　ショートフィルム『Present（仮）』
description: 『Gift（仮）』から二年後。宇久島に移住した成海は、満月の夜にだけ現れる隣人・松浦すずと出会う。竜宮城伝説や神島神社の神楽、かんころ餅など島の文化を織り込み、幻想と現実の境界を描き出します。配信などを通じて、国内外の観客に「宇久島という物語」を届ける作品です。

title: Goto Islands' Northernmost Point: Ukushima - Short Film 'Present (Tentative)'
description: 'Gift (Tentative)' two years later. Narumi, who moved to Ukushima, meets her neighbor, Matsuura Suzu, who only appears on full moon nights. The film weaves in the island's culture, including the legend of the Dragon Palace, the Kagura of Kamishima Shrine, and Kankoro mochi, depicting the boundary between fantasy and reality. It is a work that delivers 'the story of Ukushima' to audiences both domestically and internationally through distribution and other means.

title: 五島列島最北端「宇久島」　縦型ショートドラマ『Gift（仮）』
description: ネット社会に疲れ、心を閉ざした26歳の成海が、偶然たどり着いた宇久島で“見習いの閻魔”やアコウの巨樹と出会い、次第に自分を取り戻していく物語。長崎鼻遺跡や透明な海を背景に、島の自然や伝承をモチーフに描かれます。縦型映像で制作され、SNS世代に“宇久島を偶然見つける”体験を提供します。

title: Goto Islands' Northernmost Island 'Ukushima' Vertical Short Drama 'Gift (Tentative)'
description: A story about 26-year-old Narumi, who, tired of the online world and closing her heart, accidentally arrives at Ukushima, where she meets an 'apprentice Enma' and a giant Akou tree, gradually regaining herself. Set against the backdrop of the Nagasaki Nose ruins and transparent seas, it depicts the island's nature and traditions. Produced in a vertical format, it offers the SNS generation an experience of 'accidentally discovering Ukushima.'

title: 宇久島観光動画”塩田みうの旅log!vol.2”
description: 宇久島観光大使塩田みうの夏休み！プライベートで訪れた長崎県五島列島最北端、宇久島でフレッシュ旅行♪遊んで潜って食べて寝る！島の名産かんころ餅や大人気の島ちゃんぽんを楽しんで、昔ながらの町並みを横目にぶらぶら。自分では気付かない間にデトックス。心にゆとりが出来る旅行です！独りでも、グループでも、家族でも！賑やかな観光地とは違う魅力が沢山詰まった宇久島へレッツゴー！

title: Ukushima Tourism Video: Miu Shiota's Travel Log! Vol. 2
description: Miu Shiota, the Ukushima tourism ambassador, enjoys her summer vacation! A fresh trip to Ukushima, the northernmost island of the Goto Islands in Nagasaki Prefecture, visited privately. Enjoying the island's specialty, kankoro mochi, and the popular island champon while strolling past the old townscape. Detoxing without even realizing it. A trip that brings peace of mind! Whether alone, in a group, or with family! Let's go to Ukushima, filled with many charms different from bustling tourist spots!

title: 宇久島観光動画"塩田みうの旅log! vol.1"
description: 宇久島観光大使塩田みうの夏休み！プライベートで訪れた長崎県五島列島最北端、宇久島でフレッシュ旅行♪遊んで潜って食べて寝る！普段できないのどかな時間を存分に楽しみます！心の充電できてますか？何もない島だからこそ向き合える自分時間の旅にレッツゴー！！

title: Ukushima Tourism Video 'Miu Shiota's Travel Log! vol.1'
description: Miu Shiota, the Ukushima tourism ambassador, enjoys her summer vacation! A fresh trip to Ukushima, the northernmost island of the Goto Islands in Nagasaki Prefecture, visited privately. Playing, diving, eating, and sleeping! Enjoying the peaceful time that is usually not possible! Are you recharging your heart? Let's go on a journey of self-reflection that can only be faced on an island with nothing!

title: 宇久島観光動画”夏は宇久島！”
description: Nagasaki Prefecture's Ukushima, located at the northernmost tip of the Goto Islands, boasts the highest transparency of water in Nagasaki Prefecture! Marine experiences such as SUP and swimming are popular! However, the best aspect of the island is its 'lack of people.' As shown in the video, the beaches (location: Ohama Beach) are rarely crowded with tourists. The tranquility and kindness that characterize Ukushima should recharge your heart. Please visit at least once; we are waiting for you leisurely. (Featuring: Miyu Yoshimoto)

description: 2017年夏、アカウミガメがスゲ浜海水浴場にて産卵、無事にふ化シーン撮影に成功しました！みんなで固まって必死に砂から出てくる様子は涙モノです…！砂から出てきた後は無事にみんな海に帰っていきました。人が誘導する訳でもなく、砂から出てきたら自分の場所がわかっているかのように、迷うことなく海に一直線。生き物の持って生まれた能力はただただ不思議です。

title: 2017 Sea Turtle Hatching Scene
description: In the summer of 2017, the loggerhead turtles laid their eggs at Sugehama Beach, and we successfully captured the hatching scene! The sight of them desperately emerging from the sand in a group is truly moving...! After coming out of the sand, they all returned to the sea safely. Without any human guidance, it was as if they knew their destination, heading straight for the ocean without hesitation. The innate abilities of living creatures are simply mysterious.

title: Yoron Island Your own life, your own voyage.  4K(Francais)
description:
WEB SITE
https://etooto.jp/

The title “Nichinichi kore Yoron” is an homage to the Zen phrase, “Nichinichi kore kojitsu” which means “Everyday is a good day so we appreciate every moment of our life and every moment is special. Live life just the way it is. “
We’ve learned how important it is to appreciate every moment of our life during the pandemic. 
Tourism is one of the sectors most affected by the COVID-19 pandemic. Yoron Island is no exception.
Every year, the island is suffers from severe typhoons which has an impact on the tourist economy. Yoron Island also survived the harsh realities of WWII. 
The theme of this film is to display the power and beauty of nature resilience as it accepts everything life throws at it.
We will tell the story of the strength and beauty of Yoron island through the use of personification.
We want to encourage the people of Yoron Island and other Islands suffering from depopulation.

title: ヨロン島 あなた自身の人生、あなた自身の航海。 4K(フランス語)
description:
ウェブサイト
https://etooto.jp/

タイトル「日々これよろん」は、禅の言葉「日々これ好日」に敬意を表したもので、「毎日が良い日であり、私たちの人生のすべての瞬間を感謝し、すべての瞬間が特別である。ありのままの人生を生きる。」という意味です。
私たちは、パンデミックの間に人生のすべての瞬間を大切にすることがどれほど重要であるかを学びました。
観光業はCOVID-19パンデミックの影響を最も受けたセクターの一つです。ヨロン島も例外ではありません。
毎年、島は観光経済に影響を与える厳しい台風に悩まされています。ヨロン島はまた、第二次世界大戦の厳しい現実を生き延びました。
この映画のテーマは、自然の力と美しさの回復力を示すことであり、自然は人生が投げかけるすべてを受け入れます。
私たちは、擬人法を用いてヨロン島の強さと美しさの物語を語ります。
私たちは、過疎化に苦しむヨロン島や他の島々の人々を励ましたいと考えています。

title: ともによろこぶ Celebrate Tomonoura Together  -Japanese-【鞆の浦】
description:
WEB SITE
https://etooto.jp/

鞆の浦のことを地元では「鞆＝とも」と呼びます。
日本語で「友」「朋」「共」といった響きを持つこの名には、鞆の浦の人びとが大切にしてきた自然との共生、家族や友だちと支え合いながら生きてきた言霊が宿ります。
本映像「時をともに」を通して、しばし、日本遺産認定「鞆の浦」に息づく穏やかでやさしい時間にお帰りください。

●第三章「ともによろこぶ」では、
のどかな港町が一丸となって盛り上がる10の祭事・神事を紹介。
よろこびをもって日々をくりかえす鞆の浦の暮らしに触れてみましょう。

title: Celebrate Tomonoura Together -Japanese-【鞆の浦】
description:
WEB SITE
https://etooto.jp/

In the local area, Tomonoura is referred to as 'Tomonoura = Tomo'.
This name, which resonates with the Japanese words for 'friend', 'companion', and 'together', embodies the spirit of coexistence with nature that the people of Tomonoura have cherished, as well as the bonds of support among family and friends.
Through this video 'Together in Time', we invite you to return to the gentle and peaceful moments that breathe life into the Japan Heritage recognized 'Tomonoura'.

In Chapter 3 'Celebrate Together', we introduce 10 festivals and rituals that bring the tranquil port town together in celebration.
Let’s experience the daily life of Tomonoura, where joy is repeated.

description:
WEB SITE

title: 田舎館村 冬の田んぼアート２０２２「花時の日の出」
description: 「冬の田んぼアート２０２２」は、新型コロナウイルスの感染拡大を防止するため、やむを得ず、中止となりましたが、青森県では、田舎館村及びスノーアーティスト集団「It’s OK」の協力のもと制作したスノーアートの映像を公開します。スノーアートのテーマは「花時の日の出」です。「花時」とは、春にいろいろな花が咲き始める時期のことを指し、特に桜を指すことが多いそうです。そのように、桜が咲き始める頃までに新型コロナウイルス感染症が収束し、日の出のように未来が明るくなることを祈って制作しました。

title: Inakadate Village Winter Rice Field Art 2022 'Sunrise of Flower Time'
description: The 'Winter Rice Field Art 2022' has been unfortunately canceled to prevent the spread of the novel coronavirus. However, in Aomori Prefecture, a video of the snow art created in cooperation with Inakadate Village and the snow artist group 'It’s OK' will be released. The theme of the snow art is 'Sunrise of Flower Time.' 'Flower Time' refers to the time in spring when various flowers begin to bloom, often specifically referring to cherry blossoms. It was created with the hope that by the time the cherry blossoms begin to bloom, the COVID-19 pandemic will be over, and the future will be bright like the sunrise.

title: 2020蕪島のサンドアート　タイムラプス
description: ウミネコの繁殖地である蕪島でサンドアート制作の様子をタイムラプス動画にしました。動画だとあっという間ですが、今回の制作には約５時間かかっています。制作者の城前さんはサンドアートをすべて独学で習得し、今年の８月頃から作り始めたそうです。蕪島を訪れる人との交流も楽しいそうなので、見かけたら話しかけてみてくださいね。

title: 2020 Kabushima Sand Art Time-lapse
description: This is a time-lapse video of sand art production at Kabushima, a breeding ground for black-tailed gulls. Although the video seems quick, the production took about five hours. The creator, Mr. Jomae, learned sand art entirely on his own and started making it around August this year. He seems to enjoy interacting with visitors to Kabushima, so feel free to talk to him if you see him.

title: 2020ザボンの月（種差海岸の満月） タイムラプス
description: 草野心平が「ザボンの月」と称した種差海岸の満月は、上がり始めは赤く、徐々に黄色くなっていくとともに、月の明かりに海が照らされて、幻想的な銀色の道が現れます。 そしてハマギク・アヅマギクの群生する突端に登つたとき。ザボンのやうな満月が。浮きあがつた。草野新平「種差海岸」1973年

title: 2020 Zabon no Tsuki (Full Moon at Tanesashi Coast) Time-lapse
description: The full moon at Tanesashi Coast, referred to as 'Zabon no Tsuki' by Shinpei Kusano, starts off red and gradually turns yellow, illuminating the sea with moonlight and creating a fantastical silver path. When I climbed to the tip where the beach daisies and eastern daisies grow, the full moon like a Zabon rose up. Shinpei Kusano 'Tanesashi Coast' 1973.

title: これが、青森県の本気のリンゴCMだ！「あおもりんご」CM
description: 青森県では、リンゴ試験場で約３００種、県内で約５０種のリンゴが栽培されており、日本一の生産量を誇ります。(そのうち、市場に出荷されているのは約４０種類程度) 本CMには本物の青森のリンゴ農家のみなさんが出演し、しりとりを繰り広げます。真冬の雪を溶かすような、素人とは思えない熱演を是非ご覧ください！さらに、CMの中にも登場する「リンゴのポスト」や「リンゴ型のつり革」、「リンゴ型のカーブミラー」、「リンゴ型の駅のホームの無線」など、街中の至るところにまでリンゴ愛があふれる青森県。この青森県の圧倒的なリンゴの種類の多さとあふれるリンゴ愛を知ってもらいたいとの思いから、今回のCMを制作いたしました。1月から3月にかけて、出荷量が最も多くなる青森県のリンゴ。スーパーで選ぶ際はぜひ、青森県産のリンゴをご賞味ください！

title: This is Aomori's Serious Apple Commercial! 'Aomorin' CM
description: In Aomori Prefecture, about 300 varieties of apples are cultivated at the Apple Research Station, and about 50 varieties are grown in the prefecture, boasting the highest production volume in Japan. (Of these, about 40 varieties are shipped to the market.) In this commercial, real Aomori apple farmers participate and engage in a game of shiritori. Please watch their impressive performances that melt the winter snow, which are hard to believe are from amateurs! Furthermore, Aomori is filled with love for apples, with apple-themed items such as 'apple post boxes', 'apple-shaped handrails', 'apple-shaped convex mirrors', and 'apple-shaped wireless stations' appearing throughout the city. This commercial was created to share the overwhelming variety of apples and the abundant love for apples in Aomori Prefecture. From January to March, Aomori apples have the highest shipping volume. When choosing apples at the supermarket, please enjoy Aomori-grown apples!

title: 漁師の一日　風間浦のアンコウ漁
description: 木村喜志雄さんが伝統的な「からばり」を使った唯一の漁師である青森県風間浦村のアンコウ漁。冬の津軽海峡での漁は厳しいですが、温泉や昔からの仲間たちが漁の疲れを癒してくれます。漁師の一日を通して、青森ならではの暮らしぶりを紹介します。

title: A Day in the Life of a Fisherman: Angler Fishing in Kazamaura
description: Kimura Kishiou is the only fisherman using the traditional 'karabari' in angler fishing in Kazamaura, Aomori Prefecture. Fishing in the Tsugaru Strait during winter is tough, but hot springs and old friends help relieve the fatigue of fishing. This introduces the unique lifestyle of Aomori through a fisherman's day.

description: 2018年7月12日、青森県田舎館村にて田んぼアート「手塚治虫キャラクター」を一挙撮影！

description: Aomori Blog
