description: The only breathtaking view in Japan is now available! I climbed the Shiriya Cape Lighthouse. The left side of the screen is the Tsugaru Strait, and the right side is the Pacific Ocean. From the Shiriya Cape Lighthouse, which was opened to the public on June 1, 2018.

title: DELISH AOMORI「津軽あかつきの会　古津軽伝承料理」vie
description: 弘前市石川地区。３０人ほどの「かっちゃ」が集まり、地域の伝承料理の復活と保存に取り組んでいるのが「津軽あかつきの会」です。使う食材のほとんどが地元産。雪に閉ざされる冬の季節には、発酵・乾燥・塩蔵といった伝承された技術を凝らした「古津軽伝承料理」でもてなしてくれます。訪れた人を温かく迎えてくれる「津軽あかつきの会」の雰囲気までお届けする、DELISH AOMORIのSpecial Movieです。

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Tsugaru Akatsuki no Kai Ancient Tsugaru Traditional Cuisine'
description: In the Ishikawa district of Hirosaki City, about 30 'kaccha' gather to work on the revival and preservation of local traditional cuisine through the 'Tsugaru Akatsuki no Kai'. Most of the ingredients used are locally sourced. During the winter season, when snow covers the area, they welcome visitors with 'Ancient Tsugaru Traditional Cuisine' that incorporates traditional techniques such as fermentation, drying, and salting. This is a special movie from DELISH AOMORI that conveys the warm atmosphere of 'Tsugaru Akatsuki no Kai' that welcomes visitors.

title: DELISH AOMORI「風間浦村のあんこうのベーコン巻き」
description: The recipe video 'Delish Aomori' delivered by all of Aomori is finally at its last episode, the 12th. The final ingredient is the anko from Kazamaura Village. Kazamaura Village is very close to the fishing grounds for anko, and exceptionally fresh anko is landed. When you think of anko, the first thing that comes to mind is probably anko nabe (stew). The recipe introduced this time is 'Bacon-Wrapped Anko', which can be enjoyed deliciously in a Western style. The combination of the mild anko flesh and the umami and saltiness of the bacon is exquisite. We will also deliver the lively atmosphere of the Kazamaura Anko Appreciation Festival, which is held once a year in Kazamaura Village.

description: The recipe video 'Delish Aomori' delivered by all of Aomori is finally at its last episode, the 12th. The final ingredient is the anko from Kazamaura Village. title: DELISH AOMORI「ふかうら雪人参のポタージュ」
description: This is the 11th recipe video of 'DELISH AOMORI', delivered by all of Aomori. The ingredient this time is 'Fukaura Snow Carrot', cultivated in Fukaura Town. We have created a potage soup that deliciously captures the fruity sweetness that is unlike any other vegetable while enjoying the flavor of the carrot itself. Please give it a try.

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Fukaura Snow Carrot Potage'
description: まるごと青森がお届けするレシピ動画「DELISH AOMORI」の第１１弾。今回の食材は深浦町で栽培される「ふかうら雪人参」。野菜とは思えないほどフルーティーな甘みを活かしつつ、人参そのものの風味を美味しく味わえるポタージュスープに仕上げています。ぜひお試しください。「DELISH AOMORI」はまるごと青森Facebookで随時公開します。

title: DELISH AOMORI「津軽百年食堂　清おばあちゃん」
description: Kuroishi-shi no Konan Tetsudo Kuroishi Eki-mae ni mise o kakumeru 'Sugou Shokudo' wa Taisho jidai kara 4 dai ni watatte uketsugare, 'Tsugaru Hyakunen Shokudo' no 1 ten ni kazoeraremasu. Genzai no ten'nushi, Sugou Kiyo-san wa 87-sai to natta ima demo, chouri tantou to shite gen'eki de mise ni tachi tsuzukete iru obaachan desu. Mise to tomo ni hyakunen uketsugaru kawaranai aji to, dokoka natsukashisa o oboeru mise no fun'iki o tsutaeru, DELISH AOMORI ga otodoke suru Special Movie desu.

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Tsugaru Hyakunen Shokudo Kiyo Obaachan'
description: Located in front of Kuroishi Station on the Konan Railway in Kuroishi City, 'Sugou Shokudo' has been passed down for four generations since the Taisho era and is counted as one of the 'Tsugaru Hyakunen Shokudo'. The current owner, Kiyo Sugou, is an 87-year-old grandmother who still stands in the kitchen as the cook. This is a Special Movie brought to you by DELISH AOMORI that conveys the unchanging taste passed down for a hundred years along with the nostalgic atmosphere of the shop.

title: DELISH AOMORI「大間マグロのマグロカツ」
description: まるごと青森がお届けするレシピ動画「DELISH AOMORI」。第１０弾はあの有名食材、大間のマグロ。刺身で食べてももちろん最高に美味しいのは間違いないですが、カリッとサクサクの衣、中身はとろけるレアのカツに仕上げました。やっぱり大間のマグロは美味しいです！「DELISH AOMORI」はまるごと青森Facebookで随時公開します。

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Tuna Cutlet from Oma'
description: This is a recipe video series 'DELISH AOMORI' brought to you by Aomori. The 10th installment features the famous ingredient, Oma tuna. It's undoubtedly delicious when eaten as sashimi, but we've made it into a crispy, crunchy cutlet with a melt-in-your-mouth rare inside. Oma tuna is truly delicious! 'DELISH AOMORI' will be released on the Aomori Facebook page.

title: DELISH AOMORI「八戸前沖さばの洋風味噌煮」
description: まるごと青森がお届けするレシピ動画「DELISH AOMORI」の第９弾。今回の食材は八戸前沖さば。さばの最も定番とも言える味噌煮を洋風にアレンジ。脂の乗ったさばの美味しさが詰まった一皿に仕上げました。いつもとはちょっと違った晩ごはんのおかずにどうぞ。 「DELISH AOMORI」はまるごと青森Facebookで随時公開します。

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Western-style Miso Braised Hachinohe Mackerel'
description: This is the 9th installment of the recipe video 'DELISH AOMORI' brought to you by Marugoto Aomori. The ingredient this time is Hachinohe mackerel. We have arranged the classic miso braised mackerel in a Western style. This dish is packed with the deliciousness of fatty mackerel. Enjoy it as a slightly different side dish for dinner. 'DELISH AOMORI' will be released on the Marugoto Aomori Facebook page.

title: DELISH AOMORI「三沢の長芋アヒージョ」
description: まるごと青森がお届けするレシピ動画「DELISH AOMORI」。第８弾の食材は三沢市で栽培されている長芋。今回のレシピは長芋を皮ごと使ったアヒージョです。皮ごと調理することで、手にはかゆみが起きず、栄養もしっかり摂れます。「DELISH AOMORI」はまるごと青森Facebookで随時公開します。

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Misa's Nagaimo Ajillo'
description: A recipe video delivered by all of Aomori, 'DELISH AOMORI'. The 8th ingredient is nagaimo grown in Misawa City. This recipe is ajillo using nagaimo with the skin on. title: 【Niijima・Shikinejima】Minpaku Gohan Shikine Taihei-kun de Kanpai
description: Since the start of shipping in 1990, over 30 years have passed for the aquaculture business in Niijima Village. We planned to create a video to let the residents of Niijima know more about it. (Background) Selling outside the island is difficult due to costs for customers, and it’s hard to sell whole fish. It’s clear that we need to create a cycle where we can ‘grow’, ‘cook’, and ‘eat’ within the island. We often hear the disappointing voice that ‘island fish are hard to get’. One solution to that voice is the stable supply of farmed sea bream, ‘Shikine Taihei-kun’. After updating the breeding environment over 30 years, we have developed a unique blended feed that realizes the delicious taste of sea bream with just the right amount of fat. When you think of sea bream, you might imagine the stylish and bright red ‘medetai’, but Shikine Taihei-kun is a rustic-colored ‘irodori tai’. Why not add some color to the sea bream that is so close to you? ‘Let’s grow together!’

title: 210602 NHK 首都圏ネットワーク ちかさとコレクション
description: 300年以上続く島の伝統食「くさや」をミライへ 島の暮らしを支えてきたキレイな海をミライへ 〜アルミ型洗濯バサミ #HOSSY を通じて海洋ゴミ問題を考える〜 【新島ミライプロジェクト】 新島では年間100トン以上という大量の海洋ゴミが流れ着き、ごみ処理はもちろん、島の美しい景観を損ねる大問題となっています。一方、魚の水揚げ量は年々減少し、漁業や水産加工業は今、苦境に立たされています。このまま海の環境が悪化していけば、海と共に生きてきた島の暮らしが立ち行かなくなるかもしれません。 そこで新島水産加工業協同組合は、海の恵みから生まれた伝統食「くさや」を受け継ぐ者として、海と共に生きる暮らしを未来へつないでいく活動を始めます。その第一弾として、アルミ製洗濯バサミ「HOSSY（ホッシー）」を新島のすべてのお宅へ配布（１家庭につき２０個）し、海を汚すプラゴミを少しでも減らしていくことを目指します。

title: 210602 NHK Shuto-ken Network Chikasato Collection
description: A traditional island food 'Kusaya' that has continued for over 300 years towards the future. A beautiful sea that has supported island life towards the future. - Considering the marine debris problem through aluminum clothespins #HOSSY - 【Niijima Mirai Project】 Niijima faces a significant problem with over 100 tons of marine debris washing ashore each year, affecting waste disposal and damaging the island's beautiful scenery. Meanwhile, the catch of fish has been decreasing year by year, putting the fishing and seafood processing industries in a difficult position. If the marine environment continues to deteriorate, the island's way of life, which has lived in harmony with the sea, may not be sustainable. Therefore, the Niijima Fisheries Processing Cooperative will begin activities to connect the way of life living with the sea to the future as inheritors of the traditional food 'Kusaya' born from the blessings of the sea. As the first step, they aim to distribute aluminum clothespins 'HOSSY' to all households in Niijima (20 per household) to reduce plastic waste that pollutes the sea.

description: 2021年春、東京の島　新島から島内全家庭のプラスティック洗濯バサミを、くさや型のアルミ製洗濯バサミ　”HOSSY" との交換を目指すプロジェクトです。紫外線で劣化し、すぐに壊れるプラスティック洗濯バサミを島のシンボルである”くさや型洗濯バサミ”に換えることにより、島の大切な産業である、くさやをより身近に感じてもらい、何より、もう壊れて捨てることのない洗濯バサミに交換することで、プラスティックのゴミを出さない生活へと変えていきたいと考えています。海から恵みをいただき発展してきた島だから、「今こそ自然環境に対し、何ができるか？」を島の人たち一人一人が考える機会の創出です。今後は、東京宝島の力もお借りし、同時に企業様の力もお借りしたいと願っております。もちろん私たちでもクラウドファンディングを行い、少しでも多くの方にコミットいただきたいと考えています。そして新島での取り組みを、東京諸島の全11島へ広げ、その先にこのアクションを日本の島々へ広めて行きたいと考えております。狙いは2つ。①日本の食文化への理解 “干物（くさや）”から、郷土への誇りを高めるとともに、②難しく考えがちな “環境問題”をユニークな取組みで、気づきの連鎖につなげたい。それは【新しい、でつながる島】だから。海と生きるまち。海の環境問題に正面から取り組む「エコアイランド構想」への環境アクションです。

title: 【新島ミライプロジェクト】210402 CX Live News it!
description: In spring 2021, this project aims to exchange plastic clothespins from all households on Niijima Island, Tokyo, for aluminum clothespins shaped like kusaya, called 'HOSSY'. By replacing plastic clothespins that deteriorate and break easily due to UV rays with the island's symbol, the kusaya-shaped clothespin, we hope to make the important industry of kusaya more familiar and, most importantly, to change to clothespins that will not break and be thrown away, leading to a lifestyle that does not produce plastic waste. Since the island has developed by receiving blessings from the sea, we want to create opportunities for each islander to think about 'What can we do for the natural environment now?'. In the future, we hope to borrow the power of Tokyo's treasure islands and also the strength of companies. Of course, we also plan to conduct crowdfunding ourselves to get as many people as possible to commit. We aim to expand our efforts in Niijima to all 11 islands of the Tokyo Islands and then spread this action to the islands of Japan. There are two aims: 1) To enhance understanding of Japanese food culture through 'dried fish (kusaya)' and pride in our hometown, and 2) To connect the often complex 'environmental issues' to a chain of awareness through unique initiatives. This is because it is a 'new island connected by new things'. A town that lives with the sea. It is an environmental action towards the 'Eco-Island Concept' that directly addresses marine environmental issues.

title: A trip to Niijima Island
description:
The way to enjoy the island is up to you. That is the Niijima way.

Meet the stunning colors of the sea. The clear grains of sand.

The breathtaking 7 kilometers of the white mama cliffs. The life of the island etched in Koga stones.

And talk to the open-minded islanders.

There are people who will enjoy and find joy in the treasures you discover together.

A new door opens with a chain of encounters.

To a new Niijima, bringing new experiences to your life.

title: 【式根島】 A Trip to Shikinejima Island
description: 〜 A place to work, a place to play. 新しい「なつかしい」をつくる島 〜 働き方、休み方を変える。例えば、週末を、あるいは一週間を、仕事とバケーションを両立させる「ワーケーション」。そんな生活のシフトチェンジに絶好の島があります。東京からジェット船で、３時間。古き良き時代の懐かしも品格のあるたたずまい。そこに息づく穏やかな暮らしに、新しい時代のワークスタイルが融合する島、式根島。すぐそばには、紺碧の海と青い空、２４時間フリーな温泉、緑豊かな大自然が待っています。仕事に、生活に、本当に必要な情報は何か。人生の大事な時間や価値を洗い直すには、いま島が必要です。そんな思いを共にする人たちと島が一緒になって、どんな新しい暮らし方や働き方がつくれるか。さぁ、住んでよし、働いてよしの式根島へ。東京と島のデュアルライフ、移住・定住、大歓迎。式根島式、未来づくりに、あなたもご参加を。

title: 【Shikinejima Island】 A Trip to Shikinejima Island
description: A place to work, a place to play. Creating a new 'nostalgic' island. Changing the way we work and take breaks. For example, balancing work and vacation with 'workation' on weekends or even for a week. There is an ideal island for such a shift in lifestyle. Just three hours by jet boat from Tokyo, it has a nostalgic charm of the good old days with a dignified presence. The island of Shikinejima, where a peaceful way of life coexists with a new era of work style. Right nearby, the deep blue sea and sky, 24-hour free hot springs, and lush nature await. What is truly necessary information for work and life? To reassess the important time and value of life, we need the island now. Together with people who share this sentiment, what new ways of living and working can we create? Come to Shikinejima, where living and working are both great. A dual life between Tokyo and the island, migration and settlement are very welcome. Join us in creating the future in the Shikinejima way.

title: Discover Ikeda#002 Let's Go to the Flower Temple 'Kyu-an-ji'【Kyu-an-ji】
description: The second installment of Discover Ikeda is Kyu-an-ji located in Fuseo, Ikeda City! It is also famous as the 'Flower Temple' and is bustling with many people during the hydrangea and autumn foliage seasons! Zen meditation and sutra copying experiences are also available, which are highly recommended! For more about the experiences at Kyu-an-ji, visit: https://kyuanji.jp/experience.html

You might feel that 'bonsai' is a bit intimidating, but everyone is friendly and will teach you kindly. Various bonsai experiences, including the potted planting experience that Tori is trying, are also available.

title: STUNNING NAGOYA  A Unique and Exclusive Experience at Nagoya Castle
description: Nagoya has been the land of Samurais, giving it a rich history and unique cultural identity. Discover Nagoya's world-class meeting facilities, history, ancient traditions, and first-class dining, and be inspired by the cultural atmosphere of the city, in the heart of Japan.

title: 驚くべき名古屋 名古屋城でのユニークで特別な体験
description: 名古屋は侍の土地であり、豊かな歴史と独自の文化的アイデンティティを持っています。名古屋の世界クラスの会議施設、歴史、古代の伝統、そして一流のダイニングを発見し、日本の中心にあるこの街の文化的な雰囲気に触発されてください。

title: Spring in Nagoya
description: コロナ禍により観光渡航が途絶する中、早春の名古屋の美しさを感じていただきたく、春の精に誘われるイメージで動画を作成しました。乾杯のシーンでは、VYSA Tokai（在日ベトナム学生青年協会東海支部）のメンバーにご協力いただきました。

title: 名古屋の春
description: In the midst of the COVID-19 pandemic, when tourism has come to a halt, we created a video to convey the beauty of early spring in Nagoya, inspired by the spirit of spring. In the toast scene, we received cooperation from members of VYSA Tokai (Vietnamese Student Youth Association Tokai Branch).

title: 武將與喫茶文化
description: 名古屋と深い関係を持つ武将は古くから喫茶を好み、その影響を受けて江戸時代には平民も喫茶を楽しむようになりました。この精神文化は今でも受け継がれています。

title: Warlords and Tea Culture
description: Warlords with a deep connection to Nagoya have historically had a fondness for tea, and influenced by this, during the Edo period, common people also began to enjoy tea. This cultural spirit has been passed down to the present day.

title: 名古屋喫茶文化
description: 名古屋の喫茶店の朝食は、1杯の飲み物の価格で、他の特典も付いてきます。さらに、各店舗には独自の特色メニューがあり、さまざまな喫茶店を探索することができます。

title: Nagoya Coffee Culture
description: In Nagoya's coffee shops, breakfast is available at the price of just one drink, along with additional perks. Moreover, each shop has its own unique menu, so go explore different coffee shops!

title: 武将と喫茶文化
description: 名古屋ゆかりの武将たちのお茶を楽しむ文化は、江戸時代には庶民にまで広がりました。抹茶とお茶菓子で一服する習慣が、現代の喫茶店で一息つくというスピリッツにつながってるのでは！？といわれます。

title: Warlords and Tea Culture
description: The culture of enjoying tea associated with warlords from Nagoya spread to the common people during the Edo period. The custom of taking a break with matcha and tea sweets is said to connect to the spirit of taking a breather in modern tea shops.

title: 名古屋喫茶文化
description: 有名な「モーニング」は、ドリンク1杯の値段でおまけがついてくる。その他にも、お店ごとに特色のある喫茶メニューが豊富なので、喫茶店巡りを楽しんでみては？

title: Nagoya Coffee Culture
description: Famous for its 'morning' where you get a bonus with the price of a drink. Additionally, there are plenty of unique coffee shop menus at each store, so why not enjoy a coffee shop tour?

title: EEGANE! Come and Find, Your NAGOYA!  ~Shrines
description: NAGOYA convention & visitors bureau has produced a video promoting Nagoya to Filipinos living in Japan. The title is 'EEGANE! Come and Find, Your NAGOYA!' Megumi Marie Okada, a TV Aichi announcer born in Manila, Philippines, will be appointed to navigate the charm of Nagoya with two Filipinos living in Japan, Stephanie and Alisa. ('EEGANE!' means 'NICE!' in Nagoya dialect.) The video produced two patterns, 'Nagoya food' and 'Shrines'. Tasting the food culture 'Morning' unique to Nagoya, washing money at Yamada Tenmangu, etc. You can find your good luck in Nagoya!! It was a video that conveys the charm of Nagoya with the theme of 'experience'. Please check it out!

title: EEGANE! Come and Find, Your NAGOYA!  ~Shrines
description: 名古屋観光コンベンションビューローは、日本に住むフィリピン人向けに名古屋を紹介する動画を制作しました。タイトルは「EEGANE! Come and Find, Your NAGOYA!」です。マニラ出身のテレビ愛知アナウンサー、オカダ・メグミ・マリーが、日本に住むフィリピン人のステファニーとアリサと共に名古屋の魅力を案内します。（「EEGANE！」は名古屋弁で「素晴らしい！」という意味です。）この動画は「名古屋の食」と「神社」の2パターンを制作しました。名古屋独特の食文化「モーニング」を味わったり、山田天満宮でお金を洗ったりすることができます。名古屋で良い運を見つけてください！体験をテーマに名古屋の魅力を伝える動画でした。ぜひご覧ください！

title: 名古屋神社巡禮
description: 名古屋の神社を巡る旅は、その色とりどりの魅力に驚かされます。繁華な商業地区から静かで優雅な住宅街の隅々、のんびりとした農村から、到達するのに少し努力が必要な聖地まで、さまざまな場所がまるで日本全国を旅しているかのようです！変化に富んだ名古屋神社の旅は魅力に満ちており、出発したら止まらなくなること間違いなしです。

title: Nagoya Shrine Tour
description: Traveling around the shrines of Nagoya will amaze you with their vibrant and colorful nature. From bustling commercial areas to quiet and elegant corners of residential neighborhoods; from leisurely rural areas to sacred places that seem to require some effort to reach, various locations feel like a journey across Japan! The diverse Nagoya shrine tour is full of charm and will definitely keep you going once you set off!

title: Travel Around to Nagoya's Shrines
description: Japanese families have traditionally had a kamidana, or household Shinto altar, in their homes. Changes in lifestyles, such as the trend toward living in apartments, have led to the disappearance of these altars from many homes. However, when you venture outside, you will find many such shrines. We hope that you, coming from various parts of the world, will encounter deities in Nagoya, who always watch over us, in the belief that such an opportunity will bring you joy.

title: 名古屋の神社を巡る旅
description: 日本の家族は伝統的に家に神棚、または家庭用の神道の祭壇を持っていました。アパートに住む傾向など、ライフスタイルの変化により、これらの祭壇は多くの家庭から消えつつあります。しかし、外に出ると、そんな神社がたくさんあります。世界のさまざまな場所から来たあなたが、私たちを常に見守っている名古屋の神々に出会うことを願っています。このような機会があなたに喜びをもたらすと信じています。

title: 名古屋神社めぐり旅
description: Did you know that Aichi Prefecture has the most shrines and temples in Japan? In this area with many shrines and temples, there are over 700 'shrines' located in Nagoya city. Shrines are closely related to the history of the land, and you can enjoy various stories. How about exploring the 'shrines' in the city of Nagoya, in addition to tourist attractions and facilities?

title: Nagoya Shrine Tour
description: 愛知県は神社仏閣の数が日本一だということはご存じでしょうか？そんな神社仏閣の多いエリアにおいて、名古屋市内には700以上の「神社」が鎮座しています。神社はその土地の歴史に縁が強く、いろいろな物語を楽しむことができます。観光名所や施設以外に、名古屋の街中にある「神社」を巡ってみてはいかがでしょう。

title: 【アーカイブ】あなたの知らない名古屋オンラインツアー　名古屋城編
description: 2021年1月17日に開催した「あなたの知らない名古屋オンラインツアー　名古屋城編」のアーカイブです。名古屋おもてなし武将隊の“徳川家康”、“前田慶次”、“加藤清正”、“踊舞”、“なつ”が、名古屋城の魅力を分かりやすくツアーガイドしています。ツアーでは、初心者向けの情報から玄人向けの情報に加え、今回のオンラインツアーのために特別に撮影した「藩主・将軍　着座目線」の映像をお楽しみいただくことができます。通常の一般観覧では立ち入ることができない「表書院上段之間」・「対面所上段之間」から、400年前の藩主や将軍しか見ることのできなかった景色をご堪能ください。

title: 【Archive】The Unknown Nagoya Online Tour: Nagoya Castle Edition
description: This is the archive of the 'Unknown Nagoya Online Tour: Nagoya Castle Edition' held on January 17, 2021. The Nagoya Hospitality Samurai Team, including 'Tokugawa Ieyasu', 'Maeda Keiji', 'Kato Kiyomasa', 'Odori Mai', and 'Natsu', guides you through the attractions of Nagoya Castle in an easy-to-understand manner. The tour offers information for beginners as well as advanced insights, and you can enjoy special footage shot specifically for this online tour, featuring the 'Lord and Shogun's Eye-Level View'. Experience the scenery that only the lords and shoguns of 400 years ago could see from the 'Upper Room of the Omote Shoin' and 'Upper Room of the Taimeisho', which are normally inaccessible to the public.

title: TRAVEL ROUTINE  NAGOYA & INUYAMA 〈分散型旅行〉
description: 出張で訪れた名古屋で気になっていたスポットをめぐる女子一人旅。とある女性のトラベルルーティンをポイントで紹介しながら、一人旅の風景を切り取っています。朝、ホテルで目覚めてからのまるまる１日、名古屋と犬山を満喫できるモデルコースになっています。さあ、あなたも早起きして思う存分名古屋を満喫してみませんか。

title: TRAVEL ROUTINE NAGOYA & INUYAMA 〈分散型旅行〉

description: 2025年大阪・関西万博、ついに開幕！万博の玄関口の一つ、南海なんば駅周辺エリアの様子をお届けします！2022年から工事が進められてきた「なんば駅周辺における空間再編推進事業」が、この春、なんさん通り（南北区間）の完成をもってついに完了👏新しくなったなんば広場と、広場に接続するなんさん通りの様子を動画でご覧ください！人中心の空間に生まれ変わったなんば広場は、大阪の玄関口として、待ち合わせスポットやイベントに最適！新しくなったなんさん通り沿いの注目の新スポット、ANAスカイコネクトなんばは、4月より順次オープン✨ANA仕様のタリーズコーヒーや、ボーイングの本格シミュレーターを備えた飛行機操縦体験が楽しめます✈️夜には昔ながらのなんばの雰囲気を感じながら、お食事をお楽しみいただくのもおすすめです🍻ますます進化を続けるなんばに、ぜひお越しください！

title: 【If you go to the Expo, stop by!】The Namba Station area has been renewed

Check out the newly renovated NAMBA SQUARE and Nansan Avenue, which have just pedestrianised this March! The SQUARE has become the perfect chillout or meeting spot when you walk around Namba. You shouldn’t miss the events held in the SQUARE! Also, the newest building “ANA Sky Connect Namba,” opening this April will welcome you✨ Try the new ANA-style Tully’s Coffee and a full-scale Boeing flight simulator✈ In the evening, soak into the nostalgic mood of the city and enjoy food crawling🍻 We look forward to your visit to Namba, the continuously evolving area in Osaka!

title: 日本の産業を巡る旅へ！

title: 南海電鉄 鋼索線：新型高野山ケーブルカー運行開始！！
description:
2019年3月1日、4代目となる新型高野山ケーブルカーが運行を開始します。新型高野山ケーブルカーのコンセプトは「期待感」 「癒し・調和」 「安全・安心」。

「期待感」
客車部分はスイスのキャビンメーカーが手掛け、欧州風の流線型が特徴的なアルミ製の車体に、高野山・壇上伽藍の根本大塔を想起させる朱色をコンセプトカラーとして採用し、和洋折衷のデザインで高野山への「期待感」を醸成。

「癒し・調和」
内装は、全体に木目調の装飾を施し、調光式LEDを用いた間接照明を採用するなど「癒し・調和」を演出。

「安全・安心」
床面に滑りにくい材質を採用するとともに、車内段差部に足元灯を設置し、つまずきなどの事故防止対策を実施することで「安全・安心」を提供。

title: Nankai Electric Railway Cable Car: New Koyasan Cable Car Starts Operation!!
description:
On March 1, 2019, the fourth generation of the new Koyasan cable car will start operation. The concept of the new Koyasan cable car is 'Expectations', 'Healing and Harmony', and 'Safety and Security'.

'Expectations'
The passenger car is designed by a Swiss cabin manufacturer, featuring a European-style streamlined aluminum body, with a concept color of vermilion reminiscent of the main pagoda of Danjo Garan in Koyasan, creating an 'expectation' for Koyasan with a blend of Japanese and Western design.

'Healing and Harmony'
The interior is decorated with wood grain throughout, and indirect lighting using dimmable LEDs is adopted to create 'healing and harmony'.

'Safety and Security'
Non-slip materials are used for the floor, and footlights are installed at the steps inside the car to implement accident prevention measures such as tripping, providing 'safety and security'.

title: 南海電鉄 鋼索線：高野山ケーブルカー
description: Koyasan Cable Carは、Koyasanの聖地である高野山駅と極楽橋駅を結ぶ路線です。ケーブルカーは、法律上「鋼索鉄道」として分類され、当社では『鋼索線』と呼ばれています。1930年に開通し、高野山への参拝客や住民の交通手段として重要な役割を果たしてきました。全長0.8Km、高低差328mで、東京タワーとほぼ同じ高さを約5分で昇ります。

title: Nankai Electric Railway Cable Car: Koyasan Cable Car
description: The Koyasan Cable Car connects the terminus of the Koyasan Line, Gokurakubashi Station, with Koyasan Station, the gateway to the sacred site of Shingon Buddhism, Koyasan. The cable car is classified as a 'cable railway' under the law, and we refer to it as 'Kousakusen'. Opened in 1930, it boasts a long history and has served as a means of transportation for both visitors to Koyasan and residents. It covers a distance of 0.8 km and a height difference of 328 m, ascending to a height similar to that of Tokyo Tower in about 5 minutes.

06:57　菅原伝授手習鑑 車曳の場

左大臣時平の陰謀により、浪人となった梅王丸と桜丸が偶然出会い、互いの心境を語ります。そこへ敵の時平の牛車が道を通りかかり、今こそ仕返しをと二人は牛車に襲い掛かります。立ちはだかった時平に仕える松王丸、三人は兄弟で牛車を挟んでもみ合いになります。その時、牛車の中から時平が姿を現し、凄まじい威厳に二人はすくみ上がってしまいます。そこで松王丸は二人を斬ろうとしますが、時平は二人を許します。三兄弟は後に決着をつける約束をしてその場を後にするのでした。

Due to the conspiracy of Minister Tokihira, the ronin Umeomaru and Sakuramatsu accidentally meet and share their feelings. At that moment, the enemy Tokihira's cart passes by, and the two decide to attack it for revenge. Matsuo, who serves Tokihira, stands in their way, and the three brothers struggle around the cart. At that moment, Tokihira appears from inside the cart, and the two are frozen in awe at his tremendous dignity. Matsuo tries to kill the two, but Tokihira forgives them. The three brothers promise to settle their differences later and leave the scene.

島文楽保存会(愛知県一宮市)

傾城阿波の鳴門 巡礼歌の段

徳島は玉木家の家宝、名刀「国次」を探すため、十郎兵衛、お弓の夫婦は三歳の娘お鶴を国許に残し、諸国を巡るが、じきに金銭も尽き、悪事を重ね尋者となってしまいます。九歳になったお鶴は、両親に会いたい一心から、巡礼姿で諸国遍路の旅に出ていました。ある日、大阪に身を隠すお弓の元に、偶然、巡礼姿のお鶴が訪れます。お弓は話を聞くうちに、間違いなく我が娘、お鶴であることに気がつきます。今すぐに抱きしめ、母と名乗りたい思いを抑え、娘に罪が及ぶことを恐れて、国へ帰るよう諭すお弓ですが、お鶴は「どうやら母さんのように思われて」と泣き、ここにおいてほしいと頼むのでした。同演目を岐南町伏屋獅子舞保存会が獅子芝居で、島文楽保存会が文楽で上演しました。

title: Gifu's Clear Stream Cultural Festival 2024 Ginan Local Theater Performance (Shima Bunraku Preservation Society)
description:
The Gifu's Clear Stream Cultural Festival 2024 Ginan Local Theater Performance

November 9, 2024 (Saturday)
Ginan Town Fushiya Shishimai Hall

The Gifu's Clear Stream Cultural Festival 2024 Ginan Town Project
A performance featuring Fushiya's lion theater, which is an important intangible folk cultural asset of Gifu Prefecture, along with lion theater, local kabuki, and bunraku from within the prefecture, was held over two days.

Shima Bunraku Preservation Society (Ichinomiya City, Aichi Prefecture)

The section of the pilgrimage song from the play 'Keisei Awa no Naruto'

In Tokushima, in search of the family heirloom, the famous sword 'Kunisuke', the couple Jurobe and Oyu leave their three-year-old daughter Otsuru at home and travel around the country. Soon, their money runs out, and they resort to wrongdoing, becoming fugitives. At the age of nine, Otsuru, longing to see her parents, sets out on a pilgrimage journey. One day, Oyu, hiding in Osaka, unexpectedly encounters Otsuru in her pilgrimage attire. As Oyu listens to her story, she realizes that this is undoubtedly her daughter Otsuru. Suppressing her desire to embrace her immediately and introduce herself as her mother, Oyu advises Otsuru to return home, fearing that her daughter might be implicated in her troubles. However, Otsuru, crying, says, 'I feel like I might be my mother,' and pleads to stay here. The same play was performed by the Ginan Town Fushiya Shishimai Preservation Society as a lion theater and by the Shima Bunraku Preservation Society as bunraku.

description:
令和5年9月10日（日）岐南地芝居公演＠岐南町伏屋獅子舞会館

昨年に引き続き、「伏屋の獅子芝居」と県内の他の獅子芝居や地歌舞伎を同時にみられる「岐南地芝居公演」を開催しました。今年は関市獅子舞保存会と美濃歌舞伎保存会が出演しました。

On September 10, 2023 (Sunday), the Ginan Chijibai Performance will be held at the Ginan Town Fushiya Shishimai Hall. Following last year, the 'Ginan Chijibai Performance' allows audiences to enjoy 'Fushiya's Shishibai' along with other Shishibai and local Kabuki performances from within the prefecture. This year, the Seki City Shishimai Preservation Society and the Mino Kabuki Preservation Society will perform.

Kabuki 'Sannin Kichisa'

[Summary] Famous for the lines 'The moon is hazy over the white fish...' and 'This is a good omen for the spring,' this is a work by the playwright Kawatake Mokuami. On the night of Setsubun, Ojo Kichisa steals 100 ryo from a woman of the night by the Sumida River, but Obo Kichisa notices it, and the two fight over the money. A passing monk Kichisa mediates the dispute, and the three men with the same name reveal their true identities and become sworn brothers. The monk offers the 100 ryo to his father, Denkichi, but the bad money is thrown away. The 100 ryo ends up in the hands of the Obo, and Denkichi is killed by the Obo. Ojo and Obo meet the monk again, where the Obo learns for the first time that he killed the monk's father, and Ojo discovers that the woman of the night is the monk's sister. The two regret their sins and contemplate death...

title: 令和5年度岐南地芝居公演(関市獅子舞保存会)
description:
September 10, 2023 (Sunday) Ginan Local Theater Performance @ Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance Hall

Continuing from last year, we held the 'Ginan Local Theater Performance' where you can see 'Fushiya's Lion Theater' along with other lion theaters and local kabuki from within the prefecture. This year, the Seki City Lion Dance Preservation Society and the Mino Kabuki Preservation Society performed.

Lion Theater 'Koyasan'

[Summary] Shido Maru, longing to meet his father, Hoshiji (Karakaya Doshin), leaves his sick mother behind and walks alone to Koyasan. While walking on the mountain path, he encounters his father, Karakaya Doshin, and innocently asks, 'Where is Doshin now?' Doshin replies, 'Those who have just become monks are all called Doshin now,' and advises him to return. When Shido Maru tells him about his mother's illness, tears well up in Doshin's eyes. Seeing this, Shido Maru wonders if he might be his father, but Doshin says, 'Hoshiji Nyudo is currently on a pilgrimage across the country, and I do not know his whereabouts,' and urges him to hurry down the mountain to care for his mother.

title: Ginan Local Theater Performance (Seki City Lion Dance Preservation Society)
令和5年度岐南地芝居公演(岐南町伏屋獅子舞保存会)
description:
令和5年9月10日（日）岐南地芝居公演＠岐南町伏屋獅子舞会館

岐阜県にて令和6年度開催される、第39回国民文化祭 第24回全国障害者芸術・文化祭 「『清流のぎふ』文化祭2024」のプレイベントのひとつとして、今年も「岐南地芝居公演」を開催しました。「伏屋の獅子芝居」と県内の他の獅子芝居や地歌舞伎が同時にみられる公演で、今年は岐南町伏屋獅子舞保存会、関市獅子舞保存会と美濃歌舞伎保存会が出演しました。

　　道行
　　寄
　　悪魔払い
　　獅子芝居『傾城阿波の鳴門　巡礼歌の段』
　　
【あらすじ】
　徳島は玉木家の家宝、名刀「国次」を探すため、十郎兵衛、お弓(獅子)の夫婦は三歳の娘お鶴を国許に残し、諸国を巡るが、じきに金銭も尽き、悪事を重ね尋者となってしまう。
　九歳になったお鶴は、両親に会いたい一心から、巡礼姿で諸国遍路の旅に出ていた。ある日、大阪に身を隠すお弓の元に、偶然、順礼姿のお鶴が訪れる。お弓は話を聞くうちに、間違いなく我が娘、お鶴であることに気がつく。今すぐに抱きしめ、母と名乗りたい思いを抑え、娘に罪が及ぶことを恐れて、国へ帰るよう諭すお弓だが、お鶴は「どうやら母さんのように思われて」と泣き、ここにおいてほしいと頼むのであった。

title: 令和5年度岐南地芝居公演(岐南町伏屋獅子舞保存会)
description:
On September 10, 2023 (Sunday), the Ginan Local Theater Performance will be held at the Ginan Town Fushiya Shishimai Hall.

As one of the pre-events for the 39th National Cultural Festival and the 24th National Arts and Culture Festival for Persons with Disabilities, which will be held in Gifu Prefecture in 2024, the 'Ginan Local Theater Performance' was held again this year. This performance allows audiences to see 'Fushiya's Lion Dance' along with other lion dances and local kabuki from within the prefecture. This year, the Ginan Town Fushiya Shishimai Preservation Society, the Seki City Shishimai Preservation Society, and the Mino Kabuki Preservation Society performed.

　　Road Journey
　　Offering
　　Demon Exorcism
　　Lion Dance 'Keisei Awa no Naruto - Pilgrimage Song Segment'
　　
[Summary]
To search for the family treasure of the Tamaki family in Tokushima, the couple Jurobei and Oyu (the lion) leave their three-year-old daughter Otsuru at home and travel through various countries, but soon run out of money and become criminals. At the age of nine, Otsuru, longing to see her parents, sets out on a pilgrimage journey. One day, Oyu, who is hiding in Osaka, unexpectedly meets Otsuru, who is in pilgrimage attire. As Oyu listens to her story, she realizes that Otsuru is undoubtedly her daughter. Suppressing the urge to embrace her and introduce herself as her mother, Oyu advises Otsuru to return home, fearing that her daughter might be implicated in her crimes, but Otsuru, crying, pleads to stay with her, saying, 'I feel like I might be my mother.'

title: 令和6年岐南町二十歳の集い
description: 令和6年1月7日(日) 令和6年岐南町二十歳の集い＠岐南町中央公民館 広報紙『マイタウンぎなん』の特集と合わせてご覧ください。

title: 令和6年岐南町二十歳の集い
description: January 7, 2024 (Sunday) 20th Birthday Celebration in Ginan Town @ Ginan Town Central Community Center. Please check it out along with the special feature of the public relations paper 'My Town Ginan'.

title: めっちゃぎなんわかるてれび⑥伝統がめっちゃわかる
description: This is a television program from Gifu Broadcasting introducing the important intangible folk cultural asset 'Fukuyama's Lion Dance'. A female member of the preservation society passionately talks about the lion dance event held in the 5th year of Reiwa from the perspective of a performer.

title: Meccha Ginan Wakaru TV ⑥ Understanding Tradition
description: This is a television program from Gifu Broadcasting introducing the important intangible folk cultural asset 'Fukuyama's Lion Dance'. A female member of the preservation society passionately talks about the lion dance event held in the 5th year of Reiwa from the perspective of a performer.

title: めっちゃぎなんわかるてれび⑤きらびとがめっちゃわかる
description: ぎふチャン（岐阜放送）「めっちゃぎふわかるてれび」令和５年８月４日（金）放送第５回は”きらびとがめっちゃわかる”岐南町を拠点に活動するきらびと、『きらりと光る人』を紹介します。“100歳まで歩ける身体作り”をスローガンに健康講座を開く高見優貴さんと、子どもたちに読み聞かせを行う「岐南おはなしの会」の代表の伊藤美喜子さんにフォーカスしました。高見さんが開く健康講座は、ただ単に健康で長生きするだけでなく、高見さんならではの“美”を意識することで若々しさを保つことができるとのこと。そんな講座をリポーターが体験取材しました！伊藤さんが代表を務める「岐南おはなしの会」は、約40年間活動を続けており、そのメンバーの皆様に活動内容と子どもたちを惹きつける極意や活動の意義について聞いてみました！

title: Meccha Gifu Wakaru TV ⑤ Kirabito ga Meccha Wakaru
description: Gifu Channel (Gifu Broadcasting) "Meccha Gifu Wakaru TV" aired on August 4, 2023. The 5th episode focuses on "Kirabito ga Meccha Wakaru". It introduces Kirabito, who are active in Ginan Town, as "people who shine brightly." We focused on Yuki Takami, who holds health seminars with the slogan of building a body that can walk until 100 years old, and Mikiko Ito, the representative of the "Ginan Storytelling Association," which conducts reading sessions for children. Takami's health seminars not only aim for longevity but also emphasize beauty, allowing participants to maintain youthfulness. A reporter experienced this seminar! The "Ginan Storytelling Association," led by Ito, has been active for about 40 years, and we asked its members about their activities and the significance of attracting children.

title: 最高の一杯を　＃岐南ラーメンＩＣ
description: 【Ginan Ramen IC】ぎなん らーめん いんたーちぇんじ(名) 国道21号と22号、156号が交差する県下最大規模の交通量を誇る岐南インター周辺に、新店舗から老舗まで個性あふれるラーメン店が集結していること。岐南町は現在も人口増加が続く、若い世代に支持される”熱い”まちであることをこのラーメン激戦区が物語っている。

title: The Best Bowl #GinanRamenIC
description: Ginan Ramen IC is located around the Ginan Interchange, which boasts the largest traffic volume in the prefecture, where National Routes 21, 22, and 156 intersect. A variety of ramen shops, from new establishments to long-established ones, have gathered in this area. Ginan Town continues to experience population growth and is a 'hot' town supported by the younger generation, as evidenced by this ramen battleground.

title: 令和5年岐南町二十歳の集いスライドショー
description:
令和5年1月8日（日）令和5年岐南町二十歳の集い＠岐南町中央公民館

去年から成人の年齢が引き下げられ、成人式改め二十歳の集いという名で門出を祝う式が行われました。

広報紙『マイタウンぎなん』の特集と併せてご覧ください。

title: 令和5年岐南町二十歳の集いスライドショー
description:
On January 8, 2023 (Sunday), the 5th year of Reiwa, the 20th birthday gathering in Ginan Town was held at the Ginan Town Central Community Center.

Since last year, the age of adulthood has been lowered, and a ceremony to celebrate the new beginning was held under the name of the 20th birthday gathering instead of the Coming-of-Age Ceremony.

Please also check the feature in the public relations paper 'My Town Ginan'.

title: 第７１回岐阜県消防操法大会　岐南町消防団５位入賞！
description:
August 7, 2022 (Sunday) "Firefighting Appreciation Festival" 71st Gifu Prefectural Firefighting Skills Competition @ Yamagata City Ijira General Ground

Ginan Town Fire Brigade achieved 5th place among 20 fire brigades in the prefecture. This is the first award in small pump operations in 24 years!

The skills competition is held to improve the firefighting skills and morale of the fire brigade. The participating members underwent rigorous training for about four months for this competition, and even those who did not participate supported the competitors by training together.

The beautiful discipline and speed of extinguishing fires were truly impressive. My heart warmed as I saw the competitors embrace each other after completing all the operations.

Please take a look at the heroic appearance of the Ginan Town Fire Brigade until the end.

title: 5th Place Award at the 71st Gifu Prefectural Firefighting Skills Competition by Ginan Town Fire Brigade!
description:
On August 7, 2022 (Sunday), the "Firefighting Appreciation Festival" was held at the 71st Gifu Prefectural Firefighting Skills Competition at Yamagata City Ijira General Ground.

The Ginan Town Fire Brigade achieved 5th place among 20 fire brigades in the prefecture. This is the first award in small pump operations in 24 years!

The skills competition is held to improve the firefighting skills and morale of the fire brigade. The participating members underwent rigorous training for about four months for this competition, and even those who did not participate supported the competitors by training together.

The beautiful discipline and speed of extinguishing fires were truly impressive. My heart warmed as I saw the competitors embrace each other after completing all the operations.

Please take a look at the heroic appearance of the Ginan Town Fire Brigade until the end.

title: 岐南地芝居公演（岐阜歌舞伎保存会）
description:
令和４年９月１８日（日）岐南地芝居公演＠岐南町伏屋獅子舞会館

岐南町伏屋獅子舞保存会、関市獅子舞保存会、岐阜歌舞伎保存会の３団体が地芝居を競演。３年振りの会館での公演に、町内外から多くの観客が訪れ、場内は満席となりました。

0:58　口上

5:10　地歌舞伎『若緑勢曾我　外郎売』江戸時代に活躍した二代目市川園十郎によって演じられた歌舞伎十八番の一つ。工藤左衛門裕経らが富士の裾野で酒宴を始めようとすると、どこからともなく早口の外郎売が登場。長台詞の言い立てにその場にいた人々は感嘆する。この薬売りは父の仇である裕経を仇討ちしたいという思いを秘め、この酒宴に近づいた曾我五郎であった。

title: Ginan Local Kabuki Performance (Gifu Kabuki Preservation Society)
description:
On September 18, 2022 (Sunday), Ginan Local Kabuki Performance at Ginan Town Fushiya Shishimai Hall.

Three groups, the Ginan Town Fushiya Shishimai Preservation Society, the Seki City Shishimai Preservation Society, and the Gifu Kabuki Preservation Society, competed in local kabuki performances. Many spectators from inside and outside the town visited the performance, filling the venue for the first time in three years.

0:58 Introduction

5:10 Local Kabuki 'Wakamidori Sōga Uirō Uri' performed by the second generation Ichikawa Enjūrō, one of the Kabuki's eighteen masterpieces active in the Edo period. As Kudo Saemon Hirotsune and others try to start a drinking party at the foot of Mt. Fuji, a fast-talking Uirō Uri suddenly appears. The people present are amazed by the long lines. This medicine seller, who secretly harbors the desire to take revenge on Hirotsune, who is his father's enemy, approaches the drinking party as Sōga Gorō.

title: 岐南地芝居公演（関市獅子舞保存会）
description:
令和４年９月１８日（日）岐南地芝居公演＠岐南町伏屋獅子舞会館

岐南町伏屋獅子舞保存会、関市獅子舞保存会、岐阜歌舞伎保存会の３団体が地芝居を競演。３年振りの会館での公演に、町内外から多くの観客が訪れ、場内は満席となりました。

12:34　獅子芝居『朝顔日記』
日向の国藩主の娘・深雪（獅子）と宮城阿曽次郎はお家騒動で離ればなれになってしまう。縁談の話が持ち上がるが、相手が阿曽次郎と知らない深雪は縁談を嫌い放浪の旅に出る。その後、島田の宿で２人は再会するものの、盲目となった深雪は気づくことができない。

title: Ginan Local Theater Performance (Seki City Lion Dance Preservation Society)
description:
On September 18, 2022 (Sunday), Ginan Local Theater Performance at Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance Hall.

Three groups, the Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance Preservation Society, the Seki City Lion Dance Preservation Society, and the Gifu Kabuki Preservation Society, competed in local theater performances. Many spectators from inside and outside the town visited the performance, filling the venue for the first time in three years.

12:34 Lion Theater 'Asagao Diary'
The daughter of the lord of Hinata Province, Miyuki (Lion), and Miyagi Asojiro are separated due to a family feud. A marriage proposal arises, but Miyuki, unaware that the suitor is Asojiro, dislikes the proposal and embarks on a journey. Later, the two reunite at a lodging in Shimada, but blind Miyuki cannot recognize him.

title: 岐南地芝居公演（岐南町伏屋獅子舞保存会）
description:
令和４年９月１８日（日）岐南地芝居公演＠岐南町伏屋獅子舞会館

岐南町伏屋獅子舞保存会、関市獅子舞保存会、岐阜歌舞伎保存会の３団体が地芝居を競演。３年振りの会館での公演に、町内外から多くの観客が訪れ、場内は満席となりました。

0:07　道行
1:52　あいさつ
4:53　寄
6:01　悪魔払い

18:16　獅子芝居『傾城阿波の鳴門　巡礼歌の段』
お弓（獅子）は夫の悪事により尋者となってしまい、娘・お鶴を国許に残し隠れて暮らしている。ある日、お弓の元に巡礼姿のお鶴が訪れ、母と娘は再会する。しかしお弓はお鶴に罪が及ぶことを恐れ、母だと名乗ることができない。そしてお鶴に国に帰ることを諭さざるを得ないのであった。

title: Ginan Local Theater Performance (Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance Preservation Society)
description:
On September 18, 2022 (Sunday), Ginan Local Theater Performance at Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance Hall.

Three groups, the Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance Preservation Society, the Seki City Lion Dance Preservation Society, and the Gifu Kabuki Preservation Society, competed in local theater performances. Many spectators from inside and outside the town visited the performance, and the venue was full for the first time in three years.

0:07 - Road Scene
1:52 - Greeting
4:53 - Offering
6:01 - Exorcism

18:16 - Lion Dance Play 'Keisei Awa no Naruto - Pilgrimage Song Scene'
The lion, O-Yumi, has become a seeker due to her husband's misdeeds, leaving her daughter, O-Tsuru, in their homeland and living in hiding. One day, O-Tsuru, in pilgrim attire, visits O-Yumi, and mother and daughter reunite. However, O-Yumi cannot reveal herself as the mother for fear of bringing sin upon O-Tsuru. Thus, she is forced to advise O-Tsuru to return to their homeland.

title: 「岐南町 伏屋の獅子舞」予告篇
description: この映像作品は、「岐南町 伏屋の獅子舞」の予告篇として製作しました。江戸時代より受け継がれてきた「岐南町 伏屋の獅子舞」を、現代の視点でとらえ直し、わが町のクールジャパンを世界に向けて発信する、まちのプロモーション動画です。

title: Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance Trailer
description: This video work was produced as a trailer for the 'Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance'. It reinterprets the 'Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance', which has been passed down since the Edo period, from a modern perspective, and is a town promotion video that conveys our town's Cool Japan to the world.

title: OKINAWA travel film
description: この動画は、2024年2月に沖縄でのスタディツアー中に撮影した映像を使用して制作されました。映像には沖縄の魅力的な風景や伝統文化、スタディツアー中のさまざまな体験が収められています。この動画を通じて、沖縄の豊かな魅力を少しでもお伝えできれば幸いです。

title: 沖縄旅行映画
description: This video was created using footage captured during a study tour in Okinawa in February 2024. The footage showcases Okinawa's captivating landscapes, traditional culture, and various experiences from the study tour. Through this video, we hope to share a glimpse of Okinawa's rich charm with you.

title: 【金沢・能登】観光プロモーション動画　- Farm to Table -
description: Ishikawa Prefecture Kanazawa City, Noto Peninsula's tourism promotion video has been produced. The theme of the journey is 'Farm to Table'. How are the rich ingredients produced by the blessings of the magnificent nature of the Kanazawa and Noto area delivered to consumers? Visiting production sites, traditional craft workshops, and restaurants, this journey aims to understand the sustainable food culture of this region and learn about the thoughts of the people living here. Please visit and feel the charm of Kanazawa and Noto.

title: 【Kanazawa・Noto】Tourism Promotion Video - Farm to Table -
description: We have produced a tourism promotion video for Kanazawa City in Ishikawa Prefecture and the Noto Peninsula. The theme of the journey is 'Farm to Table'. How are the rich ingredients produced by the blessings of the magnificent nature of the Kanazawa and Noto area delivered to consumers? Visiting production sites, traditional craft workshops, and restaurants, this journey aims to understand the sustainable food culture of this region and learn about the thoughts of the people living here. Please visit and feel the charm of Kanazawa and Noto.

title: Ayabe Minatsuki Festival 2023
description: The Ayabe Minatsuki Festival was held again this year. Many people visited that day, and it was exciting everywhere in the city. I made this video with gratitude to everyone who supported this festival and will be looking forward to next year.

title: 綾部みなつき祭り2023
description: 今年も綾部みなつき祭りが開催されました。多くの人々がその日訪れ、街中がどこも賑わっていました。この祭りを支えてくれた皆さんに感謝の気持ちを込めてこの動画を作りました。来年も楽しみにしています。

title: NOTO - KANAZAWA Sustainable Nature & Life  - Cinematic travel film
description: The Noto Peninsula and Kanazawa, areas of traditional and sustainable living, the place teaches the woven tapestry of nature & life and how we are all connected together. I would be happy if you could feel the sustainability and gentleness from this film.

title: NOTO - 金沢の持続可能な自然と生活 - シネマティック旅行映画
description: 能登半島と金沢、伝統的で持続可能な生活の地域で、自然と生活の織りなすタペストリーと私たちがどのように繋がっているかを教えてくれる場所です。この映画から持続可能性と優しさを感じていただければ幸いです。

title: TOKYO | Japan Cinematic travel film
description: - A glimpse of emotion in the bustling days - Tokyo, the capital of Japan, continues to develop at a rapid pace. The glimple image of emotion amidst the hustle and bustle of a metropolis where people are constantly passing by.

title: 東京 | 日本の映画的旅行フィルム
description: - 喧騒の中の感情のひとしずく - 東京、日本の首都は急速に発展し続けています。人々が絶えず行き交う大都市の喧騒の中での感情のひとしずくのイメージ。

title: TOKYO with Lumix GH6 / Japan Travel cinematic vlog
description: Finally Japan border will be opened from 10th June as government announced and we are so excited to welcome our guests from overseas again! This time we made a cinematic travel Vlog of Tokyo, I stayed 3 days in Tokyo with my gear LUMIX GH6 in end of May. I hope you enjoy our video and catch a latest atmosphere of Tokyo!

title: TOKYO with Lumix GH6 / 日本旅行シネマティックVlog
description: ついに日本の国境が6月10日から開かれると政府が発表し、海外からのゲストを再びお迎えできることに興奮しています！今回は東京のシネマティック旅行Vlogを作成しました。5月末にLUMIX GH6を持って東京に3日間滞在しました。私たちのビデオを楽しんで、東京の最新の雰囲気を感じていただければ幸いです！

title: 金沢・能登アドベンチャーの旅　Kanazawa & Noto Adventure / Cinematic Travel Vlog
description: This video is a record of the fam trip that Ayabex participated in for Kanazawa and Noto Adventure Tourism in September 2021. Kanazawa and Noto are filled with wonderful attractions. We would be happy if everyone could experience the adventure trip in Kanazawa and Noto.

title: Kanazawa & Noto Adventure / Cinematic Travel Vlog
description: この動画は2021年9月に金沢・能登アドベンチャーツーリズムのファムトリップにアヤベックスが参加した際の記録動画です。金沢・能登には素晴らしい魅力が沢山詰まっています。金沢と能登で感じるアドベンチャーの旅をぜひ皆様も触れて頂けたら嬉しいです。

title: My summer moment in Kyoto - Fukuchiyama Sky Lantern - Cinematic travel Vlog
description: This is our summer moment in Kyoto. Let us share a record of sky Lantern event, which is held in 15th Aug 2021 in Fukuchiyama city of Kyoto. Organizer has been held this event few years but unfortunately this year will be the last. So we would like to share our moment in this video, I hope you enjoy beautiful lanterns in the sky!

title: 私の夏の瞬間 - 福知山のスカイランタン - シネマティック旅行Vlog
description: これは私たちの京都での夏の瞬間です。2021年8月15日に福知山市で開催されたスカイランタンイベントの記録を共有します。このイベントは数年前から開催されていますが、残念ながら今年が最後となります。この動画で私たちの瞬間を共有したいと思います。空に浮かぶ美しいランタンを楽しんでいただければ幸いです。

title: Japanese cooking class in a rural old farm house feat. Woodland Kyoto (Fukuchiyama City / Miwa Town)
description: Continuing from the previous edition of Kyotamba, we went to Miwa-cho, Fukuchiyama City with photographer Yasuto Shimizu. In this video, we challenged a Japanese cooking class at an old private farm house in Fukuchiyama. Please take a look at the many charms of old folk houses. If you have a chance, please come and visit us!

title: 日本の料理教室 - 田舎の古い農家での体験 (福知山市 / 美和町)
description: 前回の京丹波から続き、私たちは福知山市美和町に写真家の清水康人と共に行きました。このビデオでは、福知山の古い私有農家での日本料理教室に挑戦しました。古民家の多くの魅力をぜひご覧ください。機会があれば、ぜひお越しください！

title: A day in  KYOTAMBA city. Woodland Kyoto - shooting session with photographer
description: Last spring, we spend a great time in Kyotamba city, located in the central of Kyoto prefecture. Here is the video about photo session with Shimizu-san, professional photographer from Kyoto. These photos were taken to be used on website of Woodland Kyoto or any related advertisement for inbound tourism in Woodland Kyoto, at the same time we enjoyed a lot of videography as well. We hope you will like this lovely places and visit them if you have chance!

title: 京丹波市での一日。ウッドランド京都 - 写真家との撮影セッション
description: 昨春、私たちは京都府の中央に位置する京丹波市で素晴らしい時間を過ごしました。ここでは、京都のプロの写真家清水さんとの写真セッションに関するビデオを紹介します。これらの写真は、ウッドランド京都のウェブサイトや関連する観光広告に使用されるために撮影されました。同時に、私たちは多くのビデオ撮影も楽しみました。皆さんがこの素敵な場所を気に入って、訪れる機会があればいいなと思っています！

title: Sanin Kaigan coast - Digest of Kansai Plus One Trip - Japan Travel Cinematic Vlog
description: We have compiled a video of the trips to the Sanin coast area, Tottori / Tajima / Yumura / Kinosaki / Kyoto of the sea area, which we traveled from February to March. A trip to the Sanin coast is full of gourmet experiences and historical attractions. It is close to the center of Osaka and Kyoto and easily accessible by train or rental car. Please take a look!

title: 山陰海岸 - 関西プラスワン旅行のダイジェスト - 日本旅行シネマティックVlog
description: 私たちは、2月から3月にかけて旅行した山陰海岸エリア、鳥取/但馬/湯村/城崎/京都の海エリアの旅行の動画をまとめました。山陰海岸への旅行は、グルメ体験や歴史的な観光名所で満ちています。大阪や京都の中心部から近く、電車やレンタカーで簡単にアクセスできます。ぜひご覧ください！

title: Tajima - Yumura onsen - Tottori - Kansai Plus One Trip Vol.2
description: Continuing from the previous video, we would like to introduce a new destination on the Sanin Kaigan seacoast that we will visit in 3 days. This time we traveled to Tajima, Yumura Onsen, and Tottori prefecture.

title: タジマ - 湯村温泉 - 鳥取 - 関西プラスワン旅行 Vol.2
description: 前回の動画に続き、3日間で訪れる新しい目的地を紹介します。今回は、タジマ、湯村温泉、鳥取県を訪れました。

title: Kyoto by the sea, Kinosaki, Izushi - Kansai Plus One Trip Vol.1
description: This time we traveled a little further from the center of Kansai to Kyoto by the Sea, Izushi, and Kinosaki. This is a video about our journey to a new destination on the Sanin Kaigan sea coast, which takes 3 nights and 4 days.

title: 海の京都、城崎、出石 - 関西プラスワン旅行 Vol.1
description: 今回は関西の中心から少し離れ、海の京都、出石、城崎を旅しました。これは、山陰海岸での3泊4日の新しい目的地への旅の動画です。

title: KAGOSHIMA - Best Highlight / Beautiful Nature & Rich Food Culture - Japan Cinematic Travel Vlog
description: Kagoshima prefecture, located at the southernmost part of Kyushu, has many attractive points which has been protected by locals such as historical cultural assets left by the warlords of the Sengoku Period, food culture, and superb landscape of beautiful nature including Sakurajima. The video is about highlights of sightseeing spots and some activities at local farm. This is a 3-minutes video. Please enjoy it!

title: 鹿児島 - 最高のハイライト / 美しい自然と豊かな食文化 - 日本のシネマティック旅行ブログ
description: 鹿児島県は九州の最南端に位置し、戦国時代の武将たちが残した歴史的文化財、食文化、桜島を含む美しい自然の素晴らしい景観など、地元の人々によって守られてきた多くの魅力的なポイントがあります。このビデオは観光スポットのハイライトと地元の農場でのいくつかのアクティビティについてです。これは3分間のビデオです。お楽しみください！

title: Kanazawa city vol.1 SAMURAI Spirits & Food Culture – Japan Cinematic Vlog
description: Kanazawa is a city where you can experience the history, where historic buildings and quaint streets still remain. Significant historical sites such as Kenrokuen garden and the samurai residence are the heritage of the samurai have been passed down to the present day. And here you can not only see, but also hold a real Japanese sword. Surrounded by mountains and the sea, Kanazawa is also known as a treasure trove of essential ingredients. We really enjoyed the freshest seafood sushi and Japanese sake, which is also a local specialty! And, of course, we recommend making your own original sushi rolls using your favorite ingredients. We invite you to visit the Kanazawa city, the place where samurai culture and food culture originated. In our next video, we will introduce you to the traditional handicrafts inherited from the Kanazawa city. See you soon!

title: 金沢市 vol.1 SAMURAI スピリッツと食文化 - 日本のシネマティックVlog
description: 金沢は、歴史を体験できる街であり、歴史的な建物や趣のある街並みが今も残っています。兼六園や武家屋敷などの重要な歴史的名所は、武士の遺産が現在まで受け継がれています。そして、ここでは本物の日本刀を見て、触れることができます。山と海に囲まれた金沢は、食材の宝庫としても知られています。私たちは新鮮な海鮮寿司や地元の特産品である日本酒を心から楽しみました！もちろん、お気に入りの食材を使ってオリジナルの寿司ロールを作ることをお勧めします。武士文化と食文化が生まれた場所、金沢市を訪れてみてください。次の動画では、金沢市に受け継がれる伝統工芸をご紹介します。またお会いしましょう！

title: KOBE⇌NAGANO by FDA airlines/ highlight of Nagano trip - Nature & History Japan Cinematic Travel Vlog
description: We transferred by direct flight from Kobe Airport to Shinshu Matsumoto Airport and stayed in Nagano prefecture for 2 nights this time. During the trip, we visited stateliness historical buildings such as Matsumoto castle and enjoyed magnificent landscape and delicious local food. Please come and visit Nagano prefecture.

title: KOBE⇌NAGANO by FDA airlines/ 長野旅行のハイライト - 自然と歴史の日本シネマティック旅行ブログ
description: 私たちは神戸空港から信州松本空港への直行便で移動し、今回は長野県に2泊しました。旅行中、松本城などの歴史的な建物を訪れ、壮大な景色と美味しい地元の食べ物を楽しみました。ぜひ長野県に訪れてください。

title: FUKUI  Mikata Five lakes & Tsuruga /Beautiful nature & Fresh seafood - Japan Cinematic Travel Vlog
description: Our journey continues in Fukui prefecture. We visited quaint machiya accommodation and Kehi shrine in Tsuruga city. Also, we enjoyed the beautiful scenery from Mikata Five lake rainbow line and had delicious seafood from the Sea of Japan at one of the biggest fish markets that locals are proud of. Hopefully, everyone enjoyed our videos about Shiga and Fukui prefecture. Please come and visit those prefectures filled with warmth and charm of people ♪

title: 福井 美方五湖と敦賀 / 美しい自然と新鮮な海の幸 - 日本のシネマティック旅行ブログ
description: 私たちの旅は福井県で続きます。私たちは敦賀市の趣のある町家宿泊施設と慶雲寺を訪れました。また、五湖の虹ラインからの美しい景色を楽しみ、日本海の新鮮な海の幸を地元の人々が誇る最大の魚市場の一つで味わいました。皆さんが滋賀県と福井県に関する私たちの動画を楽しんでいただけたら幸いです。温かく魅力的な人々がいるこれらの県をぜひ訪れてください♪

title: FUKUI Wakasa & Obama / Historical Seafood Road and Sacred Places - Japan Travel Vlog
description: Our journey continues from Shiga to Fukui by train and bus. At first, we visited Kumagawa-juku in Fukui prefecture where the old town scenery remains. The Saba kaido was used for transporting seafoods which were caught from the Sea of Japan to Kyoto, capital city at that time. There are many historical temples and shrines in Obama city. We hope you’d enjoy its mysterious atmosphere. We will continue introduce delicious food and nice machiya in Vol.4. Please look forward to our next video.

title: 福井 若狭 & 小浜 / 歴史的海産物の道と聖地 - 日本旅行Vlog
description: 私たちの旅は、滋賀から福井へ電車とバスで続きます。最初に、福井県の熊川宿を訪れました。そこには古い町の風景が残っています。鯖街道は、日本海で捕れた海産物を当時の首都京都に運ぶために使われていました。小浜市には多くの歴史的な寺院や神社があります。その神秘的な雰囲気を楽しんでいただければ幸いです。次回の動画では、美味しい食べ物や素敵な町家を紹介します。次の動画をお楽しみに。

title: Shigaraki Pottery & Hikone History Japan Travel  Cinematic Vlog / 滋賀＆福井周遊 vol.2 土鍋ごはんと信楽焼工房見学・彦根観光
description: Our travel in Shiga is continuing from our last video. We visited a restaurant where they serve rice in earthen pots of Shigaraki ware which is one of Japanese pottery and a workshop. We learned about Shigaraki ware and how to cook delicious rice from potter. Also, we visited Taga Taisha where locals has been visited for long time and Hikone castle which is designated a national treasure. Shiga prefecture is full of spots where you can see Shigaraki ware which has been created using traditional methods, visit shrines and castles related to Japanese history and follow the tracks of locals’ lives. We will be visiting our next destination Fukui prefecture in our next video, vol.3. Please look forward to it!

title: Shigaraki Pottery & Hikone History Japan Travel Cinematic Vlog / Shiga & Fukui Tour vol.2 Earthen Pot Rice and Shigaraki Pottery Workshop Visit & Hikone Sightseeing
description: 私たちの滋賀の旅行は前回のビデオから続いています。信楽焼の土鍋でご飯を提供するレストランと工房を訪れました。信楽焼について学び、陶芸家から美味しいご飯の炊き方を教わりました。また、地元の人々が長い間訪れている多賀大社と国宝に指定されている彦根城を訪れました。滋賀県は、伝統的な方法で作られた信楽焼を見ることができるスポットや、日本の歴史に関連する神社や城を訪れ、地元の人々の生活の跡をたどることができる場所がたくさんあります。次のビデオ、vol.3では福井県を訪れる予定です。お楽しみに！

title: Excellent Omi Wagyu beef & Sake brewery Japan Travel Vlog / 滋賀＆福井周遊 vol.1滋賀編　日本三大和牛・近江牛と地酒のマリアージュ
description:
Shiga Prefecture is the starting point of this trip. The food culture has been passed down and loved by local people for long time.

We visited long-established Omi beef restaurant which has a history of over 100 years and Sake brewery in Minakuchi-cho, Koga city and heard lots of valuable story.

When you visit Shiga prefecture, please try delicious Omi beef cuisine and sake that matches it very well.

Our next video will be about traditional craft of Shiga, Shigaraki ware. Please look forward to it!

title: Excellent Omi Wagyu beef & Sake brewery Japan Travel Vlog / Shiga & Fukui Tour vol.1 Shiga Edition - Japan's Three Major Wagyu - Omi Beef and the Marriage of Local Sake
description:
滋賀県はこの旅の出発点です。食文化は長い間地元の人々に受け継がれ、愛されています。

私たちは、100年以上の歴史を持つ近江牛の老舗レストランと、甲賀市水口町の酒蔵を訪れ、多くの貴重な話を聞きました。

滋賀県を訪れた際には、美味しい近江牛料理とそれにぴったり合う日本酒をぜひお試しください。

次の動画では、滋賀の伝統工芸、信楽焼についてお届けします。お楽しみに！

title: 関西周遊トリップ 滋賀＆福井 KANSAI ROUND TRIP - SHIGA & FUKUI / The trailer /Cinematic Travel Vlog
description: This time, we traveled around Shiga Prefecture and Fukui Prefecture. It is a land full of charm, including beautiful scenery, historic castles, sake breweries, Shigaraki pottery workshops, and delicious seafood. We summarized our 4-day travelogue into a 3-minute trailer. Please take a look! The main content will be posted later, so stay tuned♪

title: Kansai Round Trip - Shiga & Fukui / トレーラー / シネマティック旅行ブログ
description: 今回、私たちは滋賀県と福井県をめぐる旅をしてきました。美しい景色はもちろん、歴史あるお城や酒造、信楽焼の工房、美味しい海の幸など魅力溢れる土地です。4日間にわたる旅行記を予告編として3分にまとめました。ぜひご覧ください！本編も後日投稿しますのでお楽しみに♪

title: 京都府綾部市・紅葉2020／Cinematic travel Vlog /by BMPCC 6K
description: The beautiful autumn season has already arrived in Kyoto. In Ayabe City, located in the northern part of Kyoto, the beautiful autumn leaves have already started to color. Why not come and visit?

title: Kyoto Prefecture Ayabe City - Autumn Leaves 2020 / Cinematic Travel Vlog / by BMPCC 6K
description: In Kyoto, the beautiful autumn season has already arrived. In Ayabe City, located in the northern part of Kyoto, the beautiful autumn leaves have already started to color. Why not come and visit?

title: 伝統と食のまちー福知山・京都 【城下町・三和・夜久野・観光PR動画】Fukuchiyama Kyoto / Japan Travel Cinematic Vlog
description: Fukuchiyama City, located in the northern part of Kyoto Prefecture, was once prosperous as the castle town of Akechi Mitsuhide and is now known as a food town with barbecue and sweets. We will convey the charm of Fukuchiyama, including unique shops in the city, traditional shrines, farm stays, and nightlife! We also had fun experiences such as wearing samurai costumes and lacquerware. Enjoy the video full of the charm of Fukuchiyama.

description: I tried a Japanese traditional game. I have never heard of a game using a fan. What is it like??

description:
英語の下に日本語があります。

私は伝統的な日本のゲーム、トセンキョを試してみました。このゲームについては以前は聞いたことがありませんでした。どんな感じなのでしょうか？

title: 鬼の住まう場所ー福知山・京都【大江町・観光PR動画】Fukuchiyama Kyoto/ Japan Travel Cinematic Vlog
description: Oe Town, located in the northern part of Fukuchiyama City, Kyoto Prefecture. This town has been known since ancient times for its legends of demons. This time, we embarked on a journey to trace the many remnants of demons that remain in Oe Town. We also spoke with local residents about the culture and myths that remain in the area, where it is said that demons still reside, such as Oe Mountain. There are many attractions, including impressive monuments, delicious food and sake, and historically significant traditional crafts, allowing you to experience the mysterious demon legends and the warm local hospitality. If you visit Fukuchiyama City, be sure to also visit Oe Town!

title: Поездка на велосипеде по Токио (тревел влог)  / Cycling in Tokyo (Travel vlog)
description: A small trip in Tokyo with a bicycle! Share cycle service is an excellent transportation. Let's enjoy cycling in Japan!

title: Cycling in Tokyo (Travel vlog)
description: 東京での自転車による小旅行！ シェアサイクルサービスは非常に便利な交通手段です。日本でのサイクリングを楽しみましょう！

title: FUKUCHIYAMA KYOTO / The trailer　福知山・京都　観光PR動画【予告編】Japan Travel Cinematic Vlog
description: 福知山市は古くは明智光秀の城下町として栄え、近年では焼肉とスイーツの町で注目を浴びている町です。大江山、夜久野町、大原神社、三和町など、たくさんの見どころがあります。私たちの3日間に渡る福知山の旅行記を予告編として2分にまとめました。

title: FUKUCHIYAMA KYOTO / The trailer
description: Fukuchiyama City, located in the northern part of Kyoto Prefecture, flourished as the castle town of Akechi Mitsuhide in the past and has recently gained attention as a town of yakiniku and sweets. There are many attractions such as Oe Mountain, Yakuno Town, Ohara Shrine, and Sanwa Town. We have summarized our three-day travel record in Fukuchiyama as a two-minute trailer.

title: Maizuru Repatriation Memorial Museum in KYOTO. Музей репатриации Майдзру в Киото. История ВМВ
description: 今回は、ユネスコの「世界の記憶」に登録されている舞鶴の帰還記念館を訪れました。ここでは、第二次世界大戦後に日本の外にいたシベリアの戦争捕虜や人々の歴史を知ることができます。戦争が終わって75年が経ち、多くの人々がそれを忘れつつあります。もう一度思い出してみませんか。博物館の上の丘には、湾の景色を望む展望台があります。舞鶴に行く際は、ぜひこの場所を訪れてください。

title: Maizuru Repatriation Memorial Museum in KYOTO
description: This time we visited the Maizuru Repatriation Memorial Museum, which is registered in the UNESCO Memory of the World register. Here you can learn about the history of Siberian prisoners of war and people who found themselves outside Japan after World War II. It has been 75 years since the end of the war, and many have begun to forget it. We invite you to remember it once again. There is an observation deck on the hill above the museum with a view of the bay. If you are in Maizuru, be sure to visit this place.

title: Maizuru, Kyoto (West Maizuru)  Майдзуру, Киото (западный Майдзуру) Japan Travel Vlog 舞鶴観光PR動画
description: 舞鶴は京都府の北端に位置する港町。この動画では西舞鶴の魅力を紹介します。中世から城下町として栄え、今も風情ある風景が残っており、街歩きやグルメ、茶畑訪問など盛りだくさんの内容です。

title: 舞鶴、京都（西舞鶴）
description: Maizuru is a port town located at the northern tip of Kyoto Prefecture. This video introduces the charm of West Maizuru. Flourishing as a castle town since the Middle Ages, it still retains many picturesque landscapes, making it perfect for walking, gourmet experiences, and visits to tea farms.

title: 東北で大自然を満喫！【トレッキング】
description: The Sanriku Coast area in Tohoku is designated as the 'Sanriku Reconstruction National Park' and is recognized as a national park in Japan. You can enjoy trekking in the great outdoors and savor fresh fish and unique local culture. Although it is still an area not widely known, those who love nature and the countryside should definitely visit!

title: Enjoy the Great Outdoors in Tohoku! 【Trekking】
description: The Sanriku Coast area in Tohoku is designated as the 'Sanriku Reconstruction National Park' and is recognized as a national park in Japan. You can enjoy trekking in the great outdoors and savor fresh fish and unique local culture. title: 【Майдзуру Киото】【Maizuru Kyoto】East Side Story / Travel in Japan / Cinematic Travel Vlog 舞鶴観光PR動画
description: 舞鶴市は京都府の北端に位置する港町。この動画では舞鶴の東側を紹介しています。ここは明治時代から軍港としての長い歴史があり、「軍艦のある海」がまさに舞鶴のトレードマークです。市内には古くから海軍ゆかりの史跡が多く残り、青い海と共に歴史を感じる美しい風景を紹介しています。ぜひ東舞鶴の魅力溢れる動画をお楽しみください。

title: 【Maizuru Kyoto】【舞鶴 京都】東側の物語 / 日本の旅行 / シネマティック旅行Vlog Maizuru観光PR動画
description: Maizuru city is a port city located at the northern end of Kyoto. In this video, we introduce the east side of Maizuru. It has a long history as a naval port since the Meiji era, and the 'sea with warships' is truly the trademark of Maizuru. There are many historical sites related to the navy in the city, showcasing beautiful scenery that makes you feel the history along with the blue sea. Please enjoy the fascinating video of East Maizuru.

title: It's now or never!! Only few people on Takeshita street Harajuku (Travel Vlog)
description: I came to Takeshita street. It is veeery crowded place before. How about now?

title: 今やらなければならない!! 原宿竹下通りの人は少ない (旅行ブログ)

description:
英語は下記に記載されています：
京都府北部のタンゴ半島の東海岸に、小さな漁村「イネ町」が隠れています。日本のヴェネツィアとも呼ばれています。
イネの伝統的な家屋は「フナヤ」と呼ばれ、ボートハウスと訳すことができます。この町は現在、重要な伝統的建物保護地区として保護されています。
今回は、マキシムがイネのボートハウスエリアを訪れ、電動自転車ツアーとイネ湾でのプライベートボートライディングを体験しました。イネの漁村の美しい夏の風景をお楽しみください。

title: Farm House Stay in Japan-Kyoto Ayabe / Ночь в сельском доме Покапока Ноэн. Киото, Аябэ. Travel Vlog
description: 綾部市は京都府の北部に位置する小さな町で、人口は33,000人です。「ポカポカ農園」は、東京から綾部に移住した串田さんが運営しています。「ポカポカ農園」は、100年以上の歴史を持つ古民家を改装したものです。串田さんは、自然に囲まれた田舎で、農薬や肥料を使わずに米や野菜を育てています。また、2019年からは、ゲストが自分で火を入れることができる伝統的な「五右衛門風呂」を楽しむことができます。自然の中でリラックスしたい方や農業体験をしたい方に最適な宿です。今回は、マキシムによる宿泊体験の動画を紹介します。

title: 日本の農家宿 - 京都の綾部 / Poka Poka Nouenの農家宿
description: Ayabe City is located in the northern part of Kyoto Prefecture, it's a small town with a population of 33,000. The “Poka Poka Nouen(Farm)” operated by Mr. Kushida, who has moved from Tokyo to Ayabe. "Poka Poka Nouen(farm)" is a renovation of an old folk house over 100 years old. Mr. Kushida grows rice and vegetables that are pesticide-free and fertilizer-free in the countryside where is full of nature. Also, from 2019, guests can enjoy the traditional "Goemon" style open-air bath which they can set the fire on their own. It is a perfect inn for those who want to relax in nature and who want to experience farming. This time, we introduce a video of lodging experience by Maxim.

title: Традиционные ремесла и искусства Японии – Японская бумага Васи из деревни Куротани / КИОТО-АЯБЭ
description: 今日は、京都府北部での日本の伝統的な和紙の製造について紹介します。私たちは、あやべ市の黒谷村を訪れ、800年以上の伝統を持つ和紙が今でも伝統的な技術で作られています。黒谷村は京都府の無形文化遺産として認識されています。この地域は多くの人にとって未開の地ですが、手作りの和紙の伝統技術を守ることで知られています。

title: Traditional Crafts and Arts of Japan – Japanese Paper Washi from Kurotani Village / KYOTO-AYABE
description: Today we will get acquainted with the traditional production of Japanese Washi paper in the north of Kyoto Prefecture. We will visit Kurotani village in Ayabe city, where paper has been made for over 800 years using traditional technologies. Kurotani village is recognized as an intangible heritage of Kyoto Prefecture. It is an unexplored area for many people, but it is well known for preserving traditional methods of making Washi.

title: 【夏紋別】JNO（実は夏も面白い）MOMBETSU観光プロモーション動画（英語表記版）
description: 【夏紋別】流氷の街 北海道紋別市は実は夏も面白い。 「オホーツク」観光といえば「流氷」を思い浮かべる方が多いのではないでしょうか？実は紋別の夏は東京と比較して湿度が高いにも関わらず、平均気温が8.7℃低い（2020年8月の気象庁統計より）ことで爽やかで過ごしやすいことをご存じでしょうか？ そんな紋別で、アザラシとのふれあい、夜景や星空を楽しめるナイトクルーズ、紋別の海の幸が満載のBBQ、そして地元民がおすすめする絶景のスポット巡りをしませんか？ この動画は、紋別商工会議所が2019年に実施した「ＪＮＯ ＭＯＭＢＥＴＳＵモニターツアー」を基に構成した、夏の紋別の魅力に特化した観光プロモーション動画です。

title: 【Summer Mombetsu】JNO (Actually, Summer is Fun) Mombetsu Tourism Promotion Video (Japanese Version)
description: The city of Mombetsu in Hokkaido, known for its drift ice, is actually fun in the summer too. When thinking of 'Okhotsk' tourism, many might picture 'drift ice.' However, did you know that Mombetsu's summer is refreshing and comfortable, with an average temperature 8.7°C lower than Tokyo, despite having higher humidity? In Mombetsu, you can enjoy interactions with seals, night cruises with beautiful night views and starry skies, BBQs filled with local seafood, and visits to recommended scenic spots by locals. This video is a tourism promotion video focused on the charm of summer in Mombetsu, based on the 'JNO Mombetsu Monitor Tour' conducted by the Mombetsu Chamber of Commerce in 2019.

【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】薩摩藩が誇る武家の歴史と絢爛な文化が薫る街並みを走る！南薩ルートver2
description: 「サイクリングターミナルりんりん」をスタート・ゴール地点とするルート。南さつま市、日置市、鹿児島市、指宿（いぶすき）市、南九州市、枕崎市、それぞれの特徴的な風景を次々に楽しめます。リアス式の海岸線を背に沈みゆく夕日が美しい東シナ海、さらには桜島、開聞（かいもん）岳が聳え立つ錦江湾の美しさが格別です。武家屋敷群や薩摩焼窯元、焼酎酒蔵、鰹本枯れ節工場など魅力に満ち溢れたエリアです。

title: Kagoshima Cycle Tourism: A Ride Through the Streets Filled with the History and Splendid Culture of the Satsuma Clan! South Satsuma Route ver2
description: This route starts and ends at the 'Cycling Terminal Rinrin'. You can enjoy the distinctive landscapes of Minamisatsuma City, Hioki City, Kagoshima City, Ibusuki City, Minamikyushu City, and Makurazaki City one after another. The beautiful sunset over the East China Sea against the backdrop of the ria coastline, as well as the stunning views of Sakurajima and Kaimondake towering over Kinko Bay, are exceptional. This area is filled with attractions such as samurai residences, Satsuma ware kilns, shochu distilleries, and katsuobushi factories.

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】ダイナミックな自然、豊かなグルメを楽しむ！大隅（おおすみ）ルートver2
description: A magnificent route that circles in an 8 shape, based at Tarumizu Port. The Osumi Peninsula is blessed with rich nature and is an active region for primary industries such as agriculture, fishing, and livestock. In addition to experiences and learning content utilizing local resources, there are also gourmet offerings unique to the region, such as fresh seafood from nearby waters and black wagyu beef. This area, with the lush Takakuma Mountains in the background and vast plains spreading out, is truly a place that embodies the word dynamic.

title: Kagoshima Cycle Tourism: Enjoy Dynamic Nature and Rich Gourmet! Osumi Route ver2
description: A magnificent route that circles in an 8 shape, based at Tarumizu Port. The Osumi Peninsula is blessed with rich nature and is an active region for primary industries such as agriculture, fishing, and livestock. In addition to experiences and learning content utilizing local resources, there are also gourmet offerings unique to the region, such as fresh seafood from nearby waters and black wagyu beef. This area, with the lush Takakuma Mountains in the background and vast plains spreading out, is truly a place that embodies the word dynamic.

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】美しい名峰と癒やしの温泉で身も心もあたたまる！霧島・姶良ルートver2
description: 鹿児島空港を拠点として8の字に周遊するルート。神話や伝説に彩られ、火山の息吹を目の前に感じさせる霧島連山の名峰、清流は四季折々に神秘的な表情を見せ、その自然美は感動的でさえあります。また、鹿児島の中央に位置し、文化史跡が溶け込む街並みのある姶良とともに、緑鮮やかな山々と輝く錦江湾や温泉まで楽しめるルートです。

title: Kagoshima Cycle Tourism: Warm Your Body and Soul with Beautiful Peaks and Healing Hot Springs! Kirishima-Aira Route ver2
description: A route that circles in an 8 shape centered around Kagoshima Airport. The majestic peaks of the Kirishima mountain range, colored by myths and legends, allow you to feel the breath of the volcano right before your eyes. The clear streams show mysterious expressions throughout the seasons, and their natural beauty is even moving. Additionally, this route allows you to enjoy the lush green mountains, the sparkling Kinko Bay, and hot springs, along with Aira, which is centrally located in Kagoshima and has streets blended with cultural historical sites.

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】霧島連山を背景に豊かに流れ出す川沿いの風景を楽しむ！川内川（せんだいがわ）流域ルートver2
description: 吉松駅をスタートし、川内川沿いに高速船ターミナル（川内港）へ向かって走るルート。随所に溢れだす湧水池、東洋のナイアガラと呼ばれるダイナミックな曽木の滝、夏の風物詩の「ほたる」、東シナ海につながる河口まで川沿いに楽しみます。霧島山系の豊富な水に支えられる稲穂の田園、銘茶を産出する茶畑の風景がどこまでも広がります。

title: Kagoshima Cycle Tourism: Enjoy the Scenic Views Along the Sendai River with the Kirishima Mountain Range in the Background! Sendai River Basin Route ver2
description: Starting from Yoshimatsu Station, this route runs along the Sendai River towards the high-speed boat terminal (Sendai Port). Enjoy the abundant spring water pools, the dynamic Sogi Falls known as the Niagara of the East, the summer tradition of 'fireflies', and the river leading to the estuary connected to the East China Sea. The landscape of rice fields supported by the rich waters of the Kirishima mountain range and tea fields producing fine tea stretches endlessly.

title: 世界自然遺産　奄美大島
description: 2021年7月に世界自然遺産に登録された奄美大島。鹿児島県は「屋久島」と合わせて２つの世界自然遺産を有する唯一の都道府県となりました。世界レベルの手つかずの自然風景が連続し、訪れる人を癒します。

title: World Natural Heritage Amami Oshima
description: Amami Oshima was registered as a World Natural Heritage site in July 2021. Kagoshima Prefecture is the only prefecture in Japan to have two World Natural Heritage sites, along with Yakushima. The world-class untouched natural scenery continues to heal visitors.

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】癒やしの自然で深呼吸！屋久島ルートをサイクリング！
description: The rich nature of Yakushima is attracting attention from around the world. Feel the vitality in the negative ion forest filled with primeval forests, and encounter wild Yakushima deer and Yakushima monkeys. Unique experiences that can only be had here are waiting for you.

title: Kagoshima Cycle Tourism: Breathe Deeply in the Healing Nature! Cycling the Yakushima Route!
description: その豊かな自然が世界からも注目を集めている屋久島。原生林が生い茂るマイナスイオンの森に生命力を感じたり、野生のヤクシカ・ヤクシマザルとひょっこり出合ったり。ここでしかできない貴重な体験があなたを待っています。

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】宇宙を身近に感じる！種子島ルートをサイクリング！
description: The Tanegashima Route offers areas where you can feel closer to space, and you can enjoy cycling while viewing the scenery of sugarcane fields typical of southern islands on both sides, as well as the beautiful island road overlooking the sea. How about experiencing activities like surfing and yoga to fully enjoy the rich nature of Tanegashima?

title: Cycling the Tanegashima Route: Feel Closer to Space!
description: The Tanegashima Route features areas where you can feel closer to space, and you can enjoy cycling while taking in the scenery of sugarcane fields typical of southern islands on both sides, as well as the beautiful island road overlooking the sea. Why not also try activities like surfing and yoga to fully enjoy the rich nature of Tanegashima?

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】歴史ロマンあふれる！甑島ルートをサイクリング！
description: 上甑島・中甑島・下甑島といちき串木野市を周遊するルート。サイクリングの醍醐味である、橋を渡る爽快感を存分に味わうことができます。古くは8000万年前の地層が残る甑島の断崖、日本遺産に認定された、薩摩の武士が生きた町～武家屋敷群「麓」を歩く～の構成資産「里麓」「手打麓」、日本の近代化に貢献した薩摩スチューデントに学ぶ「薩摩藩英国留学生記念館」など、歴史ロマンあふれる旅をぜひ。

title: Koshikijima Route: A Cycling Adventure Full of Historical Romance!
description: A route that circles around Kamikoshikijima, Nakakoshikijima, and Shimonoshikijima, as well as Ichiki-Kushikino City. You can fully enjoy the refreshing feeling of crossing bridges, which is one of the delights of cycling. Experience a journey full of historical romance, including the cliffs of Koshikijima, which retain geological layers from 80 million years ago, and the historical sites recognized as a Japanese heritage, such as the samurai town where Satsuma warriors lived - the samurai residence group 'Roku', and the 'Satsuma Domain British Student Memorial Hall' that learned from the Satsuma students who contributed to Japan's modernization.

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】日本の原風景を走る！北薩ルートをサイクリング！
description: North Satsuma, located on the border with Kumamoto Prefecture, is a place where you can enjoy nostalgic rural landscapes and scenic hot springs. The beautiful coastline with white sandy beaches offers a healing view of the orange sunset sinking into the East China Sea. Local gourmet food rich in seafood and mountain delicacies is also one of the highlights!

description: A magnificent route that loops around in a figure-eight from Tarumizu Port. The Osumi Peninsula is blessed with rich nature and is an active region for primary industries such as agriculture, fishing, and livestock. In addition to experiences and learning content utilizing local resources, there is also a variety of gourmet food unique to the region, including fresh seafood from nearby waters and black wagyu beef. This area, with the lush Takakuma mountain range in the background and vast plains spreading out, is truly a place that embodies the word dynamic.

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】美しい名峰と癒やしの温泉で身も心もあたたまる！霧島・姶良ルート
description: 鹿児島空港を拠点として8の字に周遊するルート。神話や伝説に彩られ、火山の息吹を目の前に感じさせる霧島連山の名峰、清流は四季折々に神秘的な表情を見せ、その自然美は感動的でさえあります。また、鹿児島の中央に位置し、文化史跡が溶け込む街並みのある姶良とともに、緑鮮やかな山々と輝く錦江湾や温泉まで楽しめるルートです。

title: Kagoshima Cycle Tourism: Warm Your Body and Soul with Beautiful Peaks and Healing Hot Springs! Kirishima and Aira Route
description: A route that circles in an 8 shape based on Kagoshima Airport. The majestic peaks of the Kirishima mountain range, colored by myths and legends, allow you to feel the breath of the volcano right before your eyes. The clear streams show mysterious expressions throughout the seasons, and their natural beauty is even moving. This route also allows you to enjoy the lush green mountains, the shining Kinko Bay, and hot springs, along with Aira, which is centrally located in Kagoshima and has streets blended with cultural historical sites.

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】霧島連山から豊かに流れ出す川沿いの風景を楽しむ！川内川（せんだいがわ）流域ルート
description: Start from Yoshimatsu Station and ride along the Sendai River towards the high-speed boat terminal (Sendai Port). Enjoy the abundant spring water pools, the dynamic Sogi Falls, known as the Niagara of the East, the summer tradition of 'fireflies', and the scenery along the river all the way to the estuary connected to the East China Sea. The landscape of rice fields supported by the abundant water of the Kirishima mountain range and tea fields producing famous tea stretches endlessly.

title: Kagoshima Cycle Tourism: Enjoy the Scenery Along the Sendai River Flowing Richly from the Kirishima Mountain Range!
description: Start from Yoshimatsu Station and ride along the Sendai River towards the high-speed boat terminal (Sendai Port). Enjoy the abundant spring water pools, the dynamic Sogi Falls, known as the Niagara of the East, the summer tradition of 'fireflies', and the scenery along the river all the way to the estuary connected to the East China Sea. The landscape of rice fields supported by the abundant water of the Kirishima mountain range and tea fields producing famous tea stretches endlessly.

title: 鹿児島３つの世界遺産
description: 2021年７月の「奄美大島，徳之島，沖縄島北部及び西表島」の世界自然遺産登録により，鹿児島県は「屋久島」と合わせて２つの世界自然遺産を有する唯一の都道府県となりました。世界文化遺産「明治日本の産業革命遺産」を合わせると，３つの世界遺産がある鹿児島県の歴史や文化，大自然など，それぞれの世界遺産が持つ異なる魅力をお楽しみください。

title: Kagoshima's Three World Heritage Sites
description: With the registration of the World Natural Heritage of 'Amami Oshima, Tokunoshima, Northern Okinawa Island, and Iriomote Island' in July 2021, Kagoshima Prefecture became the only prefecture in Japan to have two World Natural Heritage sites, along with 'Yakushima'. When combined with the World Cultural Heritage 'Sites of Japan's Meiji Industrial Revolution', Kagoshima Prefecture has three World Heritage sites. Enjoy the history, culture, and great nature of Kagoshima, as well as the unique attractions of each World Heritage site.

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】癒やしの自然で深呼吸！屋久島ルート
description: The rich nature of Yakushima is attracting attention from around the world. Feel the vitality in the forest of negative ions filled with primeval forests, and encounter wild Yakushima deer and Yakushima monkeys. Unique experiences that can only be had here are waiting for you.

title: Kagoshima Cycle Tourism: Deep Breaths in Healing Nature! Yakushima Route
description: その豊かな自然が世界からも注目を集めている屋久島。原生林が生い茂るマイナスイオンの森に生命力を感じたり、野生のヤクシカ・ヤクザルとひょっこり出合ったり。ここでしかできない貴重な体験があなたを待っています。

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】日本の原風景を走る！北薩ルート
description:
#Cycling, #Kagoshima

北薩は、懐かしい里山の風景や風光明媚な温泉が楽しめる場所。白い砂浜が続く美しい海岸線では、東シナ海に沈むオレンジ色の夕日に癒されます。海の幸山の幸が豊かな北薩地域のご当地グルメも楽しみのひとつ！

title: Kagoshima Cycle Tourism: Riding Through Japan's Original Scenery! North Satsuma Route
description:
#Cycling, #Kagoshima

North Satsuma, located on the border with Kumamoto Prefecture, is a place where you can enjoy nostalgic rural landscapes and scenic hot springs. The beautiful coastline with white sandy beaches offers healing views of the orange sunset over the East China Sea. Local gourmet food from the rich marine and mountain resources of the North Satsuma region is also one of the highlights!

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】宇宙を身近に感じる！種子島ルート
description: The Tanegashima Route offers areas where you can feel closer to space, and you can enjoy cycling while viewing the scenery of sugarcane fields typical of southern islands on both sides, as well as the beautiful island road overlooking the sea. How about experiencing activities such as surfing and yoga to fully enjoy the rich nature of Tanegashima?

title: Kagoshima Cycle Tourism: Feel Closer to Space! Tanegashima Route
description: The Tanegashima Route offers areas where you can feel closer to space, and you can enjoy cycling while viewing the scenery of sugarcane fields typical of southern islands on both sides, as well as the beautiful island road overlooking the sea. How about experiencing activities such as surfing and yoga to fully enjoy the rich nature of Tanegashima?

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】歴史ロマンあふれる！甑島ルート
description:
#Cycling, #Kagoshima

A route that circles around Upper Koshikijima, Middle Koshikijima, Lower Koshikijima, and Ichiki-Kushikino City. You can fully enjoy the refreshing feeling of crossing bridges, which is one of the delights of cycling. Experience a journey full of historical romance, including the cliffs of Koshikijima, which retain layers from 8,000 years ago, the town where Satsuma samurai lived, recognized as a Japanese heritage site - the samurai residence group 'Roku' - and the 'Sato Roku' and 'Teuchi Roku' components, as well as the 'Satsuma Domain British Student Memorial Museum' that contributed to Japan's modernization by learning from Satsuma students.

title: Koshikijima Route: A Journey Full of Historical Romance!

title: 【祝！世界自然遺産登録決定　奄美大島・徳之島】BREATHTAKING KAGOSHIMA〜心奪われる鹿児島
description: Island songs called Shima-uta float through the air weaving narratives from the ups and downs of daily life. Slow down and enjoy the bountiful nature, rich culture, delicious local food, and heartfelt hospitality of the islands.
